title: Experienced Media Buyer
description:
FULL-TIME GOOGLE ADS /
 ADS MANAGER / MEDIA BUYER



Performance Marketing | Paid Advertising | Lead Generation



We are looking for a highly driven, analytical, and results-focused Media Buyer to join our team full-time.



This role is ideal for someone who understands that successful paid advertising is about more than simply launching campaigns. You should enjoy testing, analysing data, identifying opportunities, and continuously optimising campaigns to improve results.



You will be responsible for managing and 
 paid advertising campaigns across
, Instagram, and Google, with the ultimate goal of turning cold and warm traffic into leads, subscribers, community members, customers, and sales.



This is a full-time position working Monday to Friday during Australian business hours. It is not suitable for candidates looking for part-time, freelance, or gig work.



ABOUT THE ROLE



As our Media Buyer, you will take ownership of the performance of paid advertising campaigns across multiple accounts.



You will work closely with our creative, content, development, and marketing teams to ensure campaigns are properly set up, tracked, tested, and continuously improved.



You will not be responsible for writing ad copy, designing graphics, or editing videos.



Instead, your focus will be on understanding what converts, testing different creative and audience combinations, analysing performance, and making data-driven decisions to improve campaign results.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Campaign Management & Optimisation



Manage and 
 and Instagram advertising campaigns.



Manage Google Ads campaigns where required.



Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.



Continuously test different videos, images, messaging, audiences, offers, placements, and campaign structures.



Analyse campaign data and make informed optimisation decisions.



Scale campaigns that are performing well while identifying and addressing underperforming campaigns.



Optimise campaigns to improve conversion rates and overall return on advertising spend.



Monitor budgets and ensure advertising spend is being allocated effectively.



Identify trends, performance issues, and opportunities before they become major problems.



Testing & Performance



We want someone who genuinely enjoys testing, testing, and testing again.



You will be expected to:



Test different creative assets and variations.



Test different audiences and targeting strategies.



Test different campaign structures and approaches.



Identify winning combinations and scale them.



Quickly recognise what is not working and make changes.



Use campaign data to continuously improve performance.



Develop and communicate clear testing hypotheses.



Tracking & Conversion



Work with developers to establish appropriate tracking for each account.



Assist with setting up general tracking and conversion tracking.



Ensure campaigns are accurately measuring the desired conversion events.



Monitor tracking and identify potential issues or inconsistencies.



Ensure campaign data is reliable enough to support optimisation decisions.



Help ensure the customer journey is properly tracked from advertisement through to conversion.



Funnel & Campaign Congruency



Ensure consistency between advertisements, landing pages, offers, and the overall customer journey.



Identify gaps or inconsistencies that may negatively affect conversion rates.



Work with the broader marketing team to improve the relationship between traffic, landing pages, content, and offers.



Understand the difference between generating traffic and generating qualified conversions.



Lead Generation & Conversion



Depending on the account, campaigns may be designed to convert cold and warm traffic into:



Subscribers



Leads containing name,
, and phone number



 Group members



Customers



Sales



Other defined conversion actions



Your responsibility is to help turn paid traffic into measurable business outcomes, not simply clicks or impressions.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Success in this role means becoming someone the team can rely on to consistently improve advertising performance through testing, analysis, and optimisation.



In your first 30–60 days, success looks like:



You understand our accounts, campaigns, audiences, funnels, offers, and conversion goals.



Campaigns are properly structured and monitored.



Tracking and conversion events are working correctly.



You can confidently identify campaign performance issues and opportunities.



You are actively testing new creative, audiences, and campaign approaches.



You can clearly explain why you are making specific optimisation decisions.



As you become established in the role, success looks like:



Campaign performance is continuously improving.



You consistently identify and scale winning campaigns and creative.



Poor-performing campaigns are identified and addressed quickly.



You develop a strong understanding of what works for different audiences and offers.



Cost per lead, cost per acquisition, conversion rates, and other relevant KPIs are actively managed.



Advertising budgets are allocated based on performance and opportunity.



Tracking issues are identified and resolved quickly.



You contribute meaningful insights and recommendations to the wider marketing team.



Ultimately, success means:



You can take responsibility for paid traffic performance and demonstrate that your work is generating measurable results for our clients and the business.



We are looking for someone who doesn't simply manage ads — we want someone who thinks like a performance marketer.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Essential



2+ years of proven hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns.



Strong experience with
 Ads and Instagram Ads.



Experience with Google Ads.



Demonstrated experience managing and optimising campaigns based on performance data.



Strong understanding of paid advertising and lead generation.



Experience with conversion tracking and campaign tracking.



Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.



Ability to interpret campaign data and turn insights into action.



Strong attention to detail.



Ability to work independently and take ownership of campaign performance.



Fast and reliable internet connection.



Excellent written and verbal communication skills.



Ability to work full-time Monday to Friday during Australian business hours.



We especially value people who:



Are naturally curious and love testing new ideas.



Think in terms of data, outcomes, and ROI.



Don't become emotionally attached to campaigns or creative that isn't working.



Are proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do.



Can identify problems and propose solutions.



Are comfortable managing multiple campaigns/accounts.



Take ownership of results.



Are constantly looking for ways to improve performance.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF...



You are looking for a part-time or gig-based position.



You have only theoretical knowledge of
 or Google Ads.



You have never managed real advertising budgets.



You prefer to simply follow instructions rather than analyse and optimise.



You don't enjoy working with numbers and performance data.



You are uncomfortable with continuous testing and experimentation.



You consider a campaign "finished" once it has been launched.



WORKING HOURS



Full-Time



Monday to Friday

Australian business hours



You must be available to work consistently during the required Australian business hours.



HOW TO APPLY



If you are an experienced Media Buyer who loves testing, optimisation, data, and getting measurable results, we would love to hear from you.



Please send the link to your CV when applying.



When applying, please also briefly tell us about your experience managing
/Instagram and Google Ads campaigns and the types of results you have achieved.

title: Sales & Operations Coordinator (Inbound Sales, Dispatch, B2B Appointment Setting) | Australian Home Services | Full-Time
description:
ABOUT US

We're an Australian home services group. Homeowners book our licensed technicians for air conditioning, electrical, plumbing, locksmith and glass work, and we also deliver trade services under contract for large organisations. We have a national network of subcontractor technicians and a small team across Australia and the Philippines.



We've automated most of our front line. An AI voice agent answers calls, takes bookings and payment, and jobs flow into our scheduling system. This role is the person behind that system. You handle what it can't, and you spend the rest of your week helping us grow.



THE ROLE, IN ORDER OF PRIORITY



1. Inbound sales and customer service

- Take the calls our AI agent hands over, close the booking and take payment by secure link

- Handle reschedules, complaints and job questions by phone, SMS and



2. Dispatch and technician coordination

- Watch the job board every day and make sure every job has the right technician

- Fix the exceptions: cancellations, no-shows, late arrivals, failed payments

- Get quotes from technicians, send them to customers and follow up until there's an answer

- Call customers after jobs for feedback and reviews



3. Outbound outreach and appointment setting

- Work target lists of Australian businesses (property managers, facilities and maintenance companies, insurers, disability and aged care providers) by LinkedIn,
 and phone, and book meetings for our General Manager

- Work lists of tradespeople and book intro calls for our Operations Manager

- Keep the pipeline clean in the CRM and report your numbers every week

You book the meeting. You don't have to close the deal.



HOW THE ROLE CHANGES

We're in peak season and the automation is still bedding in. Expect your first six weeks to be mostly phones and dispatch. As the system takes more of the front line, outreach grows to around half your week.



YOU NEED

- 2+ years of outbound B2B appointment setting or SDR work, with numbers you can show. Australian clients are a big plus.

- Phone-based inbound sales or customer service experience, comfortable closing and taking payment

- Experience coordinating or scheduling field staff, contractors or appointments

- Excellent spoken and written English. You'll talk to Australian homeowners, tradespeople and business managers every day.

- Daily CRM experience (GoHighLevel, Salesforce or HubSpot)

- Organised, direct, and willing to tell us when something isn't working. We don't want a yes-person.

- Quiet workspace, reliable internet with a backup, good headset



NICE TO HAVE

- Workflow automation experience (n8n, Make, Zapier, GoHighLevel workflows)

- Digital marketing experience (social media, Canva, Google Business Profile, website content)

- Field service software (ServiceM8 or similar)

- Trades, property, facilities or insurance industry experience



HOURS AND PAY

- Full time, Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 6:00pm Melbourne time (5:00am to 3:00pm Manila time during Australian daylight saving), with a one-hour unpaid break

- PHP 60,000 to 80,000 per month depending on experience, plus a bonus for meetings booked

- Long-term role, start as soon as possible



TO APPLY (VIDEO APPLICATIONS ONLY)

Record a video of up to 5 minutes, camera on, introducing yourself and answering questions 1 to 5 below in order. Upload it to Loom, Google Drive or YouTube (unlisted) and paste the link in your application. Make sure anyone with the link can view it.



Start your written application with the word SUMMER, then add your video link and your written answer to question 6. Applications without a video will not be considered.



ANSWER ON VIDEO

1. Describe your last role booking B2B meetings. Who did you target, which channels did you use, and how many meetings did you book per month?

2. Describe the last role where you closed sales by phone and took payment. What was the process?

3. A customer is booked for 8am tomorrow. At 5pm today the technician cancels and no other technician is confirmed for that area. What do you do, in order?

4. Which CRMs and automation tools have you used hands-on, and what did you build or run in them?

title: Real Estate Cold Caller (US Wholesaling) | Part Time, Path to Full Time | $4-5/hr
description:
We're Real Venture, a US real estate company that buys houses directly from homeowners (wholesaling). We're hiring one cold caller to talk to motivated sellers and find people who want to sell their house.



This starts part time (20 hours a week, about 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday) and moves to full time after a few weeks for the right person.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call homeowners from lists we provide (pre-foreclosure, probate, tired landlords and similar)

- Find out if they want to sell, their timeline, the condition of the house and their asking price

- Book interested sellers for a call with our team

- Log every call and note in GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Send a short end-of-day report with your numbers



You do not need to negotiate or make offers. We handle that.



SCHEDULE

- About 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, during US daytime hours (exact block confirmed when you're hired, likely US Eastern or Central time)

- Full time (40 hours) after a few weeks if it's a good fit



PAY

- $4 to $5 per hour depending on experience

- Paid on time, every time

- Raises based on results



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 6 months of cold calling experience. US real estate cold calling (wholesaling, acquisitions) strongly preferred

- Clear, confident English with a light or neutral accent

- Comfortable with rejection and keeping conversations going

- Reliable internet (at least 10 Mbps) and a backup plan for power or internet outages

- Noise-canceling headset and a quiet place to work

- Experience with GHL or a dialer (BatchDialer, CallTools, Mojo, Readymode) is a plus



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip a step will not be read)

1. Start your message with the words: READY TO DIAL

2. Attach a 1 to 2 minute voice recording where you pretend to call a homeowner and ask: "Hi, is this John? I'm calling about your house on Main Street. Would you ever consider selling it if the price was right?" Then keep the conversation going like a real call

3. Tell us how long you've cold called and what you've called for (real estate, solar, insurance, etc.)

4. List any dialers or CRMs you've used

5. Attach a screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net)



We reply to every applicant who follows the steps. Shortlisted applicants do a short live role-play call.

title: Payroll and Accounts Adimistrator
description:
Position Description



Part-Time Administration Assistant / Accounts Clerk



Company: Bungalow Building Co

Location: Maroubra, Sydney NSW

Employment Type: Part-Time

Reports To: Accounts / Finance Administrator and Management



About Bungalow Building Co



Bungalow Building Co is an established residential construction company specialising in renovations, extensions, second-storey additions and new homes throughout Sydney's Eastern Suburbs.



We are seeking a reliable, organised and detail-oriented Part-Time Administration Assistant / Accounts Clerk to support our daily business operations, particularly timesheet management, accounts payable, invoice processing, job costing and general administration.



The role requires someone who can maintain accurate records, identify discrepancies and ensure our accounting and project management systems remain up to date.



1. Timesheet and Attendance Management



Review and approve employee timesheets daily, ensuring recorded hours are accurate.



Ensure employee hours are allocated to the correct projects and cost codes.



Maintain a daily attendance spreadsheet showing which employees were working, absent or on leave.



Follow up with employees regarding missing or incomplete timesheets.



Cross-check recorded hours against site attendance and supervisor reports.



Identify discrepancies in working hours, overtime and leave.



Escalate disputed hours and unapproved overtime to management.



Prepare accurate weekly timesheet information for payroll processing.



2. Accounts Payable and Invoice Management



Invoice Uploading and Processing



Upload all supplier and subcontractor bills into Buildertrend / Wunderbuild.



Ensure invoices are entered against the correct project and cost code.



Check whether an invoice relates to an existing purchase order before uploading it as a new bill.



Ensure invoices already associated with purchase orders are not duplicated.



Match invoices against purchase orders, approved quotations, contracts and agreed pricing.



Check that invoice details, GST calculations and payment information are correct.



Maintain accurate invoice records and supporting documentation.



Invoice Verification and Overpayment Prevention



Double-check all invoices before approval to ensure the company is not being overcharged.



Verify invoice quantities, labour charges, material costs and agreed rates.



Check previous invoices and payment records to identify duplicate billing.



Ensure progress claims do not exceed the value of completed or approved works.



Identify invoices that have already been paid or partially paid.



Check that credits, discounts and previous payments have been correctly applied.



Refer discrepancies or suspected overcharges to management before processing.



Ensure invoices have the required approval before progressing to payment.



Subcontractor Invoice Processing



Review and upload subcontractor invoices into Buildertrend / Wunderbuild.



Confirm invoices are allocated to the correct project and cost code.



Verify subcontractor invoices against approved scopes, purchase orders and progress claims.



Send approved subcontractor bills through to Xero for payment processing.



Ensure only approved subcontractor bills are transferred to Xero through this workflow.



Check that invoices are not duplicated between the project management software and Xero.



Maintain accurate records of outstanding, approved and processed subcontractor invoices.

title: Phone and Patient Experience Coordinator
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

We are a U.S.-based, cash-pay functional and regenerative medicine practice on Eastern Standard Time (EST). We specialize in hormone replacement therapy, peptides, GLP-1 weight loss, and root-cause longevity care, and we provide premium, concierge-level care.



We are hiring a part-time Phone and Patient Experience Coordinator to be the warm, polished voice of our practice on the phone. This is a phone-only role focused mainly on our established patients. You will answer every inbound call, book appointments, take clear messages, make callbacks, and handle any task that needs a phone call. You will speak with patients, pharmacies, sales reps, and vendors, so you must be professional with all of them. New-patient booking will move to this role over time.



This is not an entry-level VA role. You need a great phone voice, strong judgment, and a medical office background.



Schedule: 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday (about 20 hours per week). You must be available live for the full shift. Hours may expand as our practice grows.



Call expectation: You answer every inbound call live during your shift. Missed calls are tracked in our phone system's call log.



We are a premium practice and are looking only for top-tier candidates. If you are an average VA, this is not the role for you.



Who This Role Is For

You have:

- A medical office background (front desk, patient coordinator, medical assistant, or similar)

- A great phone voice: strong spoken English, clear and warm, with a professional, confident manner

- Clear, neutral English accent (minimal accent)

- Strong judgment: you know what you can handle and what to pass to the office manager

- 2+ years of customer service or patient-facing phone experience

- The ability to speak professionally with patients, pharmacies, and sales reps alike



Experience in a hormone clinic, wellness clinic, or functional medicine practice is a plus.



You are proactive, detail-oriented, and do not wait to be told what to do. You stay calm with frustrated or confused callers and make them feel cared for.



Core Responsibilities

- Answer every inbound call live (patients, pharmacies, sales reps, and vendors) with a warm, professional manner

- Take clear, complete messages

- Return calls and voi
s the same day

- Schedule patients in our EHR system (OptiMantra)

- Book appointments for established patients over the phone, collect the patient's credit card to keep on file, and briefly review our cancellation policy using our script

- Make appointment reminder calls

- Make follow-up calls to patients who missed their appointment

- Handle calls with pharmacies and sales reps

- Make any other calls the practice needs

- When a caller has a question you cannot answer, send it to our office manager through Google Chat, get the answer, and call the patient, pharmacy, or rep back

- Follow the practice's pricing script

- Give every caller a polished first impression of a premium cash-pay practice



You will not give medical advice or make billing or refund decisions.



Requirements

- Medical office background

- A great phone voice and strong spoken and written English

- Clear, neutral English accent (minimal accent)

- Strong judgment and follow-through

- 2+ years of customer service or patient-facing phone experience

- Warm, professional, patient, and empathetic phone manner

- Comfortable handling confidential medical information and patient credit card details securely, and willing to complete HIPAA training

- Able to follow call scripts closely

- Comfortable scheduling patients in an EHR system. OptiMantra experience is a strong plus, and you must be able to learn it quickly

- Reliable internet and a quiet home office for live call answering

- Available 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM ET, Monday to Friday (long-term)



Compensation

$5 to $6/hr, about 20 hours per week. Part-time, long-term position. Hours may expand as the practice grows.



We review every application carefully and move forward only with exceptional candidates. Your audio recording and written answers are how we judge your professionalism and attention to detail.



How to Apply

Please include:

A short audio recording (1-2 minutes) introducing yourself, your clinic experience, and why you'd be a great voice for a premium medical practice. Applications without an audio recording will not be considered. Your phone voice is a core part of this role.

A brief summary of your medical office or clinic experience.

Your experience answering phones, making calls, and scheduling patients in an EHR system in a medical office, including calls with pharmacies or reps, if any. Tell us if you have used OptiMantra.

Your available start date and confirmation that you can work 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday.

The word "Concierge" in the subject line to confirm you read this fully.

About the Role

We are a commercial visual media and social media content agency serving hospitality brands, event venues, restaurants, hotels, and local businesses. We produce high-impact, visually driven content designed to stop the scroll and drive real-world bookings and foot traffic.



We are looking for a skilled Short-Form Video Editor who understands modern pacing, sound design, and commercial aesthetics. You will take raw, professionally shot footage (gimbal, slider, studio lighting, and multi-cam setups) and turn it into polished, high-retention Instagram Reels, TikToks, and promotional edits ready to post.



What You’ll Do

Edit Short-Form Vertical Content: Cut 15–60 second Reels and TikToks tailored for hospitality, food & beverage, venue tours, and brand spotlights.



Nail the Hook & Pacing: Structure edits with strong 3-second visual hooks, tight rhythmic cuts, and smooth transitions that match current social media standards without looking overly "template-y."



Sound Design & Audio Mixing: Source trending or licensed audio, balance dialogue/voiceovers, and layer subtle SFX (risers, whooshes, ambient textures) to elevate the feel of the footage.



Color & Polish: Apply clean, consistent color grading (matching Log/Rec.709 profiles) and add tasteful, readable kinetic captions or light motion graphics when needed.



Manage Fast Turnarounds: Deliver final, ready-to-post exports within 48–72 hours and handle quick revision rounds cleanly.



What We’re Looking For

Software Proficiency: Expert-level fluency in Adobe Premiere Pro (required) and working knowledge of Adobe After Effects for clean titles, speed ramps, and light motion graphics.



Commercial Taste: An eye for luxury, hospitality, and lifestyle aesthetics. You know the difference between a high-end venue promo and a loud gaming montage.



Solid Editing Rig & Fast Internet: A computer capable of smoothly editing 4K 10-bit footage and a reliable, high-speed internet connection for downloading raw shoot folders and uploading final masters via 
, Google Drive, or Dropbox.



Reliability & Communication: Responsive, deadline-driven, and able to take creative direction without needing constant hand-holding.



Bonus Points

 with the subject line "Commercial Video Editor – [Your Name]" and include:

Track outstanding inspections and follow up with relevant staff.



Ensure inspection reports, photographs and documentation are correctly filed.

Work closely with our Social Media Manager and Video Content Creator.



Monitor weekly and monthly social media content calendars across all business brands.



Ensure scheduled posts, promotional campaigns and marketing tasks are completed on time.



Follow up on outstanding marketing deliverables and coordinate content requirements with the Australian team.



Review marketing progress and include relevant updates in weekly management reports.



Ensure the marketing team remains accountable for deadlines and agreed responsibilities.



Essential Skills & Experience



Minimum 3 years of experience in operations management, team leadership, virtual assistant management or a similar supervisory role.



Proven experience managing remote employees or offshore teams.



Excellent spoken and written English.



Strong leadership, communication and problem-solving skills.



Experience monitoring employee performance, managing workloads and maintaining accountability.



Ability to prepare professional reports, coordinate meetings and track action items.



Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple departments and priorities.



Experience handling customer service escalations and maintaining professional communication standards.



High attention to detail and ability to work independently.



Confidence communicating directly with Australian business owners, employees, contractors and clients.



Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office or similar business productivity software.



Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection and a professional home working environment.



Highly Regarded



Previous experience in Australian holiday rental, property management, hospitality or accommodation businesses.



Experience managing virtual assistants or customer service teams.



Familiarity with Airbnb, 
, Vrbo or property management software.



Experience with task management platforms such as ClickUp.



Knowledge of CRM systems, scheduling software and business automation tools.



Experience with property owner communications, contractor coordination and administrative workflows.



Familiarity with Australian business culture and customer service expectations.



What We’re Looking For



We are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions or passes messages between staff.



We need someone who takes ownership, leads by example and ensures our entire offshore team is operating efficiently.



The successful candidate should be someone who:



Notices problems and takes action before management needs to intervene.



Can confidently lead employees and hold them accountable.



Is highly organised and follows through on every task.



Communicates professionally and confidently with Australian management and property owners.



Understands the importance of guest satisfaction and excellent customer service.



Can manage competing priorities without constant supervision.



Looks for ways to improve systems, workflows and team productivity.

You will be trusted with significant responsibility, so reliability, honesty, initiative and strong leadership are essential.

Resume and expected monthly salary in PHP.

Why do you believe you would be a good fit for this position?

Your availability and preferred working hours.



Your video must be recorded specifically for this application. Generic introduction videos or mass applications will not be accepted.

We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with our growing Australian business and become a trusted leader within our operations team.

title: Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist
description:
Growth Pathway to Sales Manager / Team Leader

Location: Remote – Philippines-based

About the Client



Our client is Australia's leading misfuelling specialist, providing nationwide roadside assistance to motorists who a
 put the wrong fuel in their vehicle.



Their team supports customers during stressful situations by delivering fast, professional, and empathetic service while coordinating technicians across Australia.



Staff Connect is partnering with the client to build and expand their offshore operations team in the Philippines, creating long-term career opportunities for motivated individuals with leadership potential.



The Opportunity

Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Career Progression to Sales Manager / Team Leader



This is a fast-paced, customer-focused sales role centred on converting inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings while delivering exceptional customer support.



You will manage inbound roadside assistance calls, coordinate technicians nationwide, and ensure urgent jobs are handled efficiently from start to finish.



This role is best suited to candidates with previous roadside assistance, emergency dispatch, towing, transport coordination, or high-volume dispatching experience, as the environment requires excellent multitasking skills, urgency, and confidence in managing time-sensitive situations.



Team members who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have opportunities for career progression into leadership positions and may eventually help manage the offshore team.



Performance Expectations

Successful candidates will be expected to:



- Achieve a minimum of 35 confirmed jobs sold per month

- Maintain strong inbound conversion rates

- Deliver exceptional customer service under pressure

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

- Accurately handle bookings, job updates, and technician coordination

- Maximise every inbound sales opportunity



This role is ideal for individuals who are confident in sales, highly organised, calm under pressure, and experienced in fast-paced dispatch environments.



Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Customer Service

- Handle inbound calls from customers requiring urgent roadside assistance

- Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through confident communication and objection handling

- Deliver calm, empathetic, and professional customer support

- Collect deposits and accurately record booking information

- Meet or exceed individual sales targets and performance KPIs



Dispatch & Operations Coordination

- Coordinate technicians across Australia using dispatch and booking platforms

- Monitor live jobs and technician availability in real time

- Manage cases from initial enquiry through to completion

- Communicate with customers and technicians via phone, Slack, Gmail, and SMS

- Prioritise urgent and high-pressure jobs efficiently



Quality Control & Administration

- Review jobs daily to ensure accurate completion and closure

- Identify missed opportunities, incomplete bookings, or operational issues

- Maintain accurate records in GeoOp and Xero

- Ensure ETAs, notes, discounts, and call outcomes are properly logged

- Support operational compliance and workflow accuracy



Process Improvement & Team Support

- Assist with updating templates, documents, and operational processes

- Participate in Slack huddles, training sessions, and coaching

- Support escalated customer concerns when required

- Contribute ideas to improve dispatch efficiency and customer experience

- Be comfortable participating in video meetings and team collaboration



What We're Looking For

Essential Requirements

- Minimum two (2) years' experience in:

- Roadside assistance dispatch

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Strong communication and objection-handling skills

- Excellent attention to detail when managing bookings, ETAs, and customer updates

- Calm, professional, and solutions-focused under pressure

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i
, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Gmail, and web-based dispatch systems

- Comfortable using Slack and participating in online meetings and huddles

- Reliable work-from-home setup with a stable internet connection



Highly Regarded

- Previous experience in:

- Misfuelling or fuel recovery services

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience supporting Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or team mentoring experience



What's in It for You

- Fully remote work-from-home opportunity

- Performance-based earning opportunity ranging from PHP 30,000 to PHP 120,000+ per month

- Commission and incentive structure that rewards strong sales performance

- Clear career progression pathway into leadership roles

- Ongoing training and professional development

- Opportunity to work with a growing international team

- Supportive and collaborative work environment

- Long-term career growth for high-performing team members

title: Video Editor (mid to senior)
description:
Video Editor (Mid to Senior): Theatre and Live Entertainment

bybobco | Melbourne, Australia (Remote, freelance, ongoing)



bybob.co makes the videos that sell seats. We cut trailers, promos and social content for musicals, plays, opera, ballet, dance and live music, for TV, cinema, paid social and Instagram. Recent work includes Cirque du Soleil, Opera Australia and TEG Dainty's The Songs of John Farnham. 



Our clients are producers and the agencies behind them. They sell shows in advance, often before a single frame exists, so every edit is judged on one thing: did it move tickets. The quality bar is high and the turnaround is fast.



We're looking for an experienced editor to take the edit off the founder's desk and become a regular part of how we deliver.



The role



You'll start on the work we do most:

• Show trailers and promos cut from live capture

• Opening-night and audience-reaction social proof videos

• Event highlights

• Platform-native versions of every edit, usually three to four specs per job



As you settle in, you'll:

• Take whole edits from rushes to 90% finished, ready for final sound, colour and titles

• Handle fast-turnaround jobs during a show's season



You'll be briefed clearly, trusted to find the story, and given direct feedback until the cut is right.



What we're looking for: 



A mid to senior editor who:

• Cuts to sell, not to impress. You care what a video achieves more than what it looks like

• Understands performance: pace, the moment that lands, what makes someone buy a ticket

• Thinks platform native. A 30-second cinema spot and a 9:16 Reel are different edits, not the same edit resized

• Works fast without the quality slipping

• Takes ownership and communicates clearly when something isn't working



This is not a junior role. You should be comfortable making creative decisions without a full brief, and handing back an edit that needs polishing, not reshaping.



A background in theatre, music or live entertainment is a strong advantage.



Tools and workflow



Required:

• A thorough knowledge of FCPX, and also After Effects 

• Strong music editing and cutting to rhythm

• Delivery across multiple aspect ratios and platform specs



Nice to have (but not required):

• Motion graphics and animated titles

• Colour grading

• Sound design and audio cleanup



Workflow tools we use:

• Dropbox 

• Google Sheets for briefing and project management. 



Location and availability



• We're based in Melbourne, Australia

• You can be anywhere, as long as you can work with strong overlap on Australian Eastern time

• Deadlines are set per project. Some are tight, because show seasons are four to eight weeks and the campaign can't wait. 



You'll know the turnaround before you accept the job



Trial and growth

• Every applicant we shortlist does a paid trial edit on real footage

• The goal is a long-term, ongoing working relationship

• There's room to grow into bigger shows and a larger share of the work



How we work



We're a small team that came out of theatre, not film school. We're direct, we move fast, and we don't take ourselves too seriously. You'll fit in if you:



• Love live performance, or at least respect it

• Take feedback without taking it personally

• Would rather hit the deadline than chase a perfect frame nobody asked for

• Want to cut work people see in cinemas and on the side of buses



Important application note

To show you've read this ad properly, your application must include the phrase: "sell the seats". Any application without this phrase will not be considered.

A consistent pipeline of fresh, high-performing ad creatives.

A clear testing, optimisation and scaling strategy.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

title: Brand Protection & DMCA Enforcement Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Brand Protection & DMCA Enforcement Specialist to help protect our brand, Elvarim, from unauthorized use of our brand name, product images, and copyrighted materials online.



Your main responsibility will be to monitor various advertising platforms and online marketplaces, identify unauthorized use of Elvarim’s intellectual property, submit the appropriate trademark or copyright takedown reports, and track each case until resolution.



This is an ongoing role that requires consistency, attention to detail, and familiarity with intellectual property enforcement procedures.

Key Responsibilities



Monitor Meta Ad Library, Google Ads, TikTok, Shopify stores, and Amazon for unauthorized use of the Elvarim brand name, product images, and other protected materials.

Identify and document potentially infringing advertisements, listings, websites, and product pages.

Submit trademark and copyright infringement reports through the appropriate platform reporting channels.

Follow up on submitted complaints and monitor their status until resolution.

Maintain an organized tracking spreadsheet with the following statuses:

Found

Reported

Removed

Pending



Keep records of evidence, including screenshots, URLs, dates, and report references.

Prepare and send a weekly summary every Friday detailing identified violations, submitted reports, removals, pending cases, and necessary follow-ups.

Requirements



Previous experience with DMCA takedowns, brand protection, copyright enforcement, or trademark infringement reporting.

Familiarity with reporting procedures on Meta, Google, TikTok, Shopify, and Amazon.

Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.

Ability to work independently and consistently manage repetitive monitoring tasks.

Good written English and communication skills.

Experience using Google Sheets or Excel for case tracking.

Ability to distinguish potential intellectual property violations from legitimate or authorized use.

Working Hours & Compensation



Part-time: 10–15 hours per week.

Hourly rate: $5–$7, depending on skills and relevant experience.

Remote position with a flexible working schedule.

Weekly progress report required every Friday.

Experience Screening Questions

Please answer the following questions when submitting your application:



DMCA Experience: How many years of experience do you have handling DMCA takedown requests or copyright infringement complaints?

Platform Experience: Which of the following platforms have you personally used to submit copyright or trademark infringement reports?

Meta /
 / Instagram

Google Ads

TikTok

Shopify

Amazon



Previous Cases: Can you describe at least two examples of copyright or trademark infringement cases you have handled? What was the issue, what action did you take, and what was the outcome?

Hands-on Experience: Have you personally submitted takedown requests, or have you only assisted with research and documentation? Please explain your role.

Brand Monitoring: How would you identify unauthorized use of a company’s brand name, product images, or advertisements across different websites and platforms?

Reporting Process: What information and evidence would you collect before submitting a DMCA or trademark infringement report?

Case Tracking: Have you used Google Sheets or Excel to manage and track infringement cases? If yes, what information do you typically record?

Problem-Solving: What would you do if a platform rejected a takedown request or the reported advertisement or listing remained online?

Availability: Can you commit to working 10–15 hours per week and submitting a progress report every Friday?

Rate: What is your expected hourly rate?

How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:



A brief introduction and summary of your relevant experience.

Your experience with DMCA takedowns, copyright claims, or trademark infringement reports.

The platforms you have experience working with.

Examples of similar brand protection or IP enforcement work you have handled, if available.

Your answers to all the screening questions above.

Important: We are looking for someone with practical, hands-on experience in intellectual property enforcement, not just general virtual assistant or internet research experience. Please highlight any previous takedown cases you have personally handled.

title: Virtual Ophthalmic Medical Scribe
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

We are a growing ophthalmology practice in New Jersey, USA, seeking an experienced and dependable Virtual Medical Scribe to assist with real-time clinical documentation.

The candidate will work directly with the ophthalmologist during patient encounters. During downtime, occasional assistance with patient calls, appointment scheduling, and administrative tasks may be requested.

Ophthalmology or optometry experience is highly preferred.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provide accurate, real-time medical scribing during patient encounters.

• Document patient histories, examination findings, diagnostic results, assessments, treatment plans, and follow-up recommendations as directed by the physician.

• Prepare and review patient charts before appointments.

• Assist with physician-directed clinical correspondence.

• Maintain accurate, organized, and timely documentation in the electronic medical record (EMR/EHR).

• Ensure all clinical notes are available for physician review and approval.

• Occasionally assist with answering incoming patient calls and general patient inquiries.

• Perform other administrative tasks as assigned when not actively scribing.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Degree in a healthcare-related field, such as nursing, medicine, medical technology, optometry, or a related discipline.

• Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in medical scribing or clinical documentation.

• Strong knowledge of medical terminology and clinical workflows.

• Excellent written and spoken English (C1 proficiency or higher).

• Excellent typing, listening, and real-time documentation skills.

• Experience using electronic medical records (EMR/EHR) systems.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to multitask.

• Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with the physician and office staff.

• Understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements.

• Willingness to sign applicable confidentiality agreements, HIPAA-related documents, and a Business Associate Agreement (BAA).



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Previous medical scribing experience in ophthalmology terminology or optometry.

• Experience with ModMed EMA is highly preferred.

• Familiarity with RingCentral and patient appointment scheduling.



WORK REQUIREMENTS

• Part-time, remote position: Tuesday–Thursday, 9 AM–5 PM U.S. Eastern Time (approximately 24 scheduled hours weekly). Occasional Saturday availability, with scheduling arranged in advance.

• Quiet, private, and secure workspace with a reliable computer, high-speed internet, headset, and backup internet.

• Willingness to use time-tracking software and comply with HIPAA and practice security policies.

• Commitment to punctuality, accuracy, professionalism, and long-term employment.

 your resume to

 Medical Scribe - 2026.

We are seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional interested in establishing a long-term working relationship with our growing practice.

title: Project Manager (PDS)
description:
Title: Project Manager – Proactive Digital Solutions

Location: Philippines

Hours: Aligned to the North American, UK or Australian business hours of the team you join, as required

Reporting to: TBC

Contract Type: Contractor



About Proactive

Proactive enables companies and investors to connect intelligently. We are one of the fastest growing financial media portals in the world, providing breaking news, commentary and analysis on hundreds of listed companies and pre-IPO businesses across the globe, 24/7. With offices in the UK, North America and Australia, our renowned multimedia business is complemented by quality events management, highly respected research and, through Proactive Digital Solutions, investor relations websites for listed companies around the world.

Proactive Digital Solutions (PDS) is our global digital corporate communications and website agency. PDS designs, builds and delivers corporate, investor relations and B2B websites for listed companies around the world, with proprietary IR tools, exchange newsfeeds and market data, analytics, hosting and support, from offices in London, Toronto, Vancouver, New York and Sydney.



Position Summary

As Proactive Digital Solutions continues to grow, we are looking for experienced, process-driven website Project Managers to join our teams in North America, the UK and Australia.

Working with our designers, developers and client managers, you will deliver responsive corporate and investor relations websites, microsites and IR tools for listed companies: on time, on budget and to exceptional quality. You will be the client’s main point of contact through the full project lifecycle, from kick-off to launch and handover to support.

Principal Accountabilities / Responsibilities



Project delivery

▪ Produce and run detailed project plans covering requirements, phases, milestones and dependencies: design, build, content, testing, QA, client review and launch

▪ Assign, schedule and oversee work across design and WordPress development teams in multiple regions

▪ Manage scope, change requests, risks and issues, escalating where needed

▪ Track budgets, time and resource against plan

▪ Lead QA and user acceptance testing before launch

▪ Plan around clients’ financial calendars, results dates and announcements

▪ Run end-of-project reviews so lessons learned improve future projects



Communication

▪ Keep clients clearly and regularly informed of progress, decisions, issues and risks

▪ Foster clear communication between design, development, sales and client support teams

▪ Take part in regular project status meetings with your regional team

▪ Hand over completed sites smoothly to the client support team



Systems and process

▪ Keep project records, tickets and client information up to date in our project tools and SugarCRM

▪ Help refine PDS delivery processes, templates and documentation



Person Specification – Skills and Experience Required

✓ 2+ years of experience managing website projects, ideally in a digital agency

✓ Hands-on experience delivering WordPress or other CMS-based websites

✓ Excellent spoken and written English, and confidence managing clients in North America, the UK and Australia

✓ Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several projects at once under deadline pressure

✓ Detail-oriented, with persistent follow-up and the ability to juggle shifting priorities

✓ Experience with project management tools (for example Jira, Asana, 
 or Trello)

✓ Ability to work independently in a remote team across time zones, with some flexibility for early or late activity around client announcements



Desirable

✓ Understanding of investor relations, listed company communications or the stock market

✓ Experience with CRMs and ticketing systems, ideally SugarCRM / Sugar Serve

✓ A project management qualification (for example PRINCE2, PMP or Agile / Scrum)

✓ Familiarity with Google Analytics, SEO and web accessibility standards



Work Environment – What We Offer

▪ Competitive monthly fee based on experience, paid in AUD

▪ Remote working, embedded in an established Proactive team in the UK, North America or Australia

▪ The opportunity to work with one of the best-known names in global financial media and investor relations

▪ Exposure to the financial markets and the listed companies that operate within them

▪ Access to Proactive’s AI tools and technology stack, with ongoing training and support

▪ A collaborative, fast-moving global team where high performers stand out

The ideal candidate should be comfortable to be in a constantly changing role with a high level of ambiguity - as we are a fast-moving startup operating in an ever-evolving environment. He or she should have excellent analytical, communication and management skills to succeed in this role.

Confirm the call, send reminders (day before, morning of, one hour before), and make sure both parents who need to be there are on it

If a family doesn't show up, contact them the same day and rebook them

Families who opted in but did not book. Your job is to start a real conversation, check whether they are a good fit, and book the call:

Respond fast. Speed matters: new leads get a personal reply within 5 minutes during your shift

Qualify before you book: the athlete plays competitive high school or AAU basketball, film is available, the graduation year fits what we work with, and a parent who makes decisions will be on the call

If a family is not a fit, let them down politely and point them in a helpful direction

When lead flow is quiet, you will work our list of older leads who never booked, and do outreach on Instagram to start new conversations and book calls.



Every day:



Keep every conversation, note, and athlete detail organized in our CRM (GoHighLevel). If it is not in the CRM, it did not happen

Send a short end-of-day report: new leads, conversations started, calls booked, calls that showed, film/info packets completed

One rule that matters: you never evaluate a player, predict scholarship chances, or promise recruiting results. You collect information, educate with materials we give you, and book calls. All evaluations happen on the call with Jackson.



HOURS AND PAY



Full-time, Monday to Friday, 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM US Central Time (3:00 AM to 11:00 AM Philippine Time)

$600/month base salary, paid twice a month via Wise

$25 for every qualified appointment that shows up with the athlete's film and information collected in advance

5% commission on cash collected from clients who sign up from calls you set or nurtured, paid when their payment clears (refunded payments are deducted)

Strong performers earn $1,100 to $1,400/month in total

Pro-rated 13th-month bonus

This starts with a paid 2-week trial. If it goes well, it becomes a long-term full-time role

WHAT YOU NEED



At least 1 year of experience as an appointment setter, lead nurture specialist, or a similar role for a US-based business. Experience with coaching, agency, or high-ticket offers is a strong plus

Excellent written English. Most of this job is texting with American parents, and your writing is the first impression of our company

Strong spoken English for occasional phone calls

Experience with GoHighLevel or a similar CRM

Comfortable working inside Instagram and

Reliable internet with a backup connection, a quiet workspace, and a working headset

You are detail-obsessed and organized. Families trust us with their information and their kid's future, and we take that seriously

HOW TO APPLY



Follow these steps exactly. Applications that skip a step will not be read.



Start your application with the word TIPOFF so we know you read the full post

Attach a voice recording of about 60 seconds introducing yourself and explaining why you are good at this kind of work

Answer this in writing: a parent filled out our form yesterday but did not book a call. Write the first text message you would send them

Share your numbers from your last setter role: appointments set per month, and your show rate if you know it

We are looking for someone who wants to stay and grow with us, not a short-term gig. If that is you, we look forward to your application.

title: Real Estate Acquisitions VA / Junior Acquisitions Manager | Full-Time + Bonuses
description:
Big Bear Homebuyers is hiring a Real Estate Acquisitions VA / Junior Acquisitions Manager who can help us turn leads into signed contracts.



This is not a generic VA role and it is not just a cold-calling position. The role will be a mix of outbound prospecting and handling inbound seller leads, so you must be comfortable starting conversations as well as responding quickly to homeowners who contact us. You must have previous U.S. real estate wholesaling or acquisitions experience and understand how a deal moves from the first seller conversation to a signed purchase agreement.



THE ROLE



You will be expected to take leads through the full acquisitions process:



Inbound or outbound lead → qualify seller → comp property → negotiate → make offer → follow up → signed contract



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Make high-volume outbound calls to homeowners and real estate leads

• Respond promptly to inbound calls, texts, and leads from motivated sellers

• Work both inbound and outbound opportunities through the full acquisitions process

• Speak directly with motivated sellers and build real rapport

• Qualify motivation, timeline, property condition, and asking price

• Comp properties using recent comparable sales

• Determine ARV and estimate repairs

• Understand investor pricing and calculate an appropriate offer

• Negotiate price with homeowners

• Make offers and follow up consistently by phone and SMS

• Send purchase agreements and guide sellers through signing

• Keep every lead and conversation organized in our CRM

• Hit clear activity, follow-up, offer, and signed-contract targets



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Previous U.S. real estate wholesaling or acquisitions experience is required

• You have personally comped properties and know how to determine ARV

• You understand repairs, investor pricing, and how to calculate a realistic offer

• You have personally spoken with motivated sellers and negotiated price

• You have experience following up with leads until they make a decision

• You know how to send a purchase agreement and get it signed

• Strong spoken and written English

• You sound natural, confident, and conversational on the phone — no robotic or cheesy sales scripts

• You are reliable, organized, coachable, and accountable



You must be comfortable handling both inbound and outbound seller conversations. High-volume outbound calling experience is strongly preferred. GoHighLevel experience is a plus.



WHO WILL DO WELL HERE



You are comfortable owning a lead instead of simply passing it along. You ask smart questions, think through the numbers, handle objections, make reasonable offers, and keep following up. You care about results and want to help get properties under contract.



If your background is only general virtual assistant work and you have not worked in U.S. real estate wholesaling or acquisitions, this role is not a fit.



COMPENSATION



• $600 USD per month base salary

• Uncapped performance bonuses

• Opportunities to earn bonuses based on qualified opportunities and signed or closed deals

• Compensation and responsibility can increase as you prove your results



Strong performers can earn significantly more than the base salary. This is intended to become a stable, long-term role for the right person.



SCHEDULE



This is a full-time position working primarily during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



YOU MUST HAVE



• Reliable high-speed internet

• A quiet, professional workspace

• A quality headset

• A backup internet and power solution strongly preferred



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer every question below. Generic applications or applications without the requested voice recording will not be considered.



1. How many years of U.S. real estate wholesaling or acquisitions experience do you have?

2. Have you personally comped properties before? Explain how you determine ARV.

3. Tell me about a recent property you helped get under contract. What was the ARV, seller asking price, offer price, and final contract price?

4. Have you personally negotiated price with homeowners?

5. Have you ever sent a purchase agreement and gotten it signed by a seller?

6. What CRM and real estate tools have you used?

7. Please send a short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your real estate acquisitions experience.



Please also include your resume and expected monthly salary in USD.



We are looking for someone who can help us get properties under contract — not someone who only wants to make calls.

title: Real Estate Cold Caller / Lead Setter (US Eastern, 1pm-7pm ET)
description:
We are a US real estate investment company (Big Bear Homebuyers, Tampa, Florida). We buy houses as-is from homeowners and need remote cold callers to open conversations, qualify motivated sellers, and set appointments for our acquisitions team.



This is phone work only. You will call from a power dialer on lists we already scrub. You will not close deals or send texts unless a seller has clearly agreed on the call.



PAY

- Base: $3.00 USD per hour, paid weekly

- Qualified lead bonus: $1 USD per qualified lead (motivated seller, with condition, reason for selling, timeline, what's owed and price in mind captured, and a callback booked with our acquisitions rep)

- Closed deal bonus: $100 USD for every deal from your lead that closes and funds

- Paid 1-week trial first at the hourly rate. Bonuses begin once we agree you are a fit.



DAILY EXPECTATIONS (KPIs)

- 300+ dials per shift on our power dialer

- 60+ minutes of talk time per shift

- 2 qualified leads per shift

- Accurate notes in the CRM after every conversation

- Immediate, polite handling of do-not-call requests



REQUIREMENTS

- Fluent, clear, easy-to-understand English (most important)

- Quiet workspace, professional headset, and a computer

- Stable internet plus a backup connection

- Available 1:00pm-7:00pm US Eastern Time, Monday-Friday

- Comfortable making a high volume of outbound cold calls

- Preferred: experience cold calling motivated homeowners or real estate wholesaling

- Plus: GoHighLevel CRM and a power dialer (BatchDialer, Enzo, or similar)



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call homeowners from pre-scrubbed lists using our script

- Confirm you have the owner, introduce why you are calling, and ask if they would consider an offer

- Qualify: condition, reason for selling, timeline, mortgage/what's owed, price in mind, occupancy, and who else has to agree

- Handle common objections calmly and briefly

- Book a callback with our acquisitions rep for qualified sellers

- Log every outcome and note in the CRM



HOW TO APPLY

Applications without these items will not be reviewed:

1. A recorded practice cold call (1-2 minutes) where you introduce yourself as a home buyer and handle a "not interested" objection

2. Confirm you can work 1:00pm-7:00pm US Eastern Time, Monday-Friday

3. A screenshot of your internet speed test

4. Dialer / CRM experience, if any (name the tools)

Put the word "PHONES" at the top of your application so we know you read this.



We will select a short list for a paid 1-week trial.

title: Medical Billing & Administrative Virtual Assistant (Ophthalmology)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

A growing physician-led ophthalmology practice based in New Jersey, USA. We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and dependable Medical Billing & Administrative Virtual.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in U.S. medical billing, insurance claims management, denial resolution, payment posting, and prior authorizations, in addition to excellent patient communication skills.

Medical billing and revenue cycle management will remain the primary responsibilities of this position, with additional telephone and administrative coverage during designated clinical days.

We are looking for a proactive professional who takes ownership of their responsibilities and is interested in establishing a long-term working relationship with our growing practice.

Previous experience in ophthalmology is highly preferred.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Management

• Submit, review, and follow up on medical insurance claims.

• Investigate denied, rejected, unpaid, and underpaid claims; handle corrections, resubmissions, and appeals.

• Monitor accounts receivable (A/R) and outstanding insurance balances.

• Post and reconcile insurance payments, ERAs, EOBs, contractual adjustments, and approved write-offs.

• Prepare and follow up on medication, procedure, and surgical prior authorizations using CoverMyMeds and insurance portals.

• Maintain accurate billing records and provide regular updates on outstanding claims, denials, and authorizations.

• Identify billing discrepancies and coordinate with the physician when clarification or approval is needed.

Patient Communication & Administrative Support

• Answer incoming patient calls and return missed calls through RingCentral.

• Assist with appointment scheduling, cancellations, and rescheduling.

• Address routine billing, insurance, and administrative inquiries.

• Verify insurance eligibility, copayments, deductibles, and benefits as needed.

• Document patient communications and assist with other administrative tasks as assigned.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Minimum 1–2 years of hands-on U.S. medical billing experience.

• Experience with claims submission, denial management, payment posting, and accounts receivable.

• Experience with medication and procedure prior authorizations.

• Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance, CPT, ICD-10-CM, and billing modifiers.

• Familiarity with EHR/practice management systems, clearinghouses, and insurance portals.

• Excellent written and spoken English with professional telephone communication skills.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.

• Understanding of HIPAA and willingness to sign required confidentiality and compliance agreements.

• Willingness to sign applicable confidentiality agreements, HIPAA-related documents, and a Business Associate Agreement (BAA), if required.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Ophthalmology billing experience, including ophthalmic procedures and surgeries.

• Experience with ModMed EMA/PM.

• Familiarity with TriZetto, Availity, CoverMyMeds, and RingCentral.

• Experience with New Jersey insurance plans.

• Medical billing or coding certification (CPC, CPB, or equivalent) is a plus.



WORK REQUIREMENTS

• Full-time remote position: 40 hours per week.

• Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (EST/EDT).

• Potential for additional hours as the practice grows.

• Quiet, private, and secure workspace with a reliable computer, high-speed internet, headset, and backup internet.

• Willingness to use time-tracking software and comply with HIPAA and practice security policies.

• Commitment to punctuality, professionalism, accuracy, and long-term employment.



HOW TO APPLY

Please click Apply and
 your resume to 

 Subject: Medical Billing VA 2026 – [Your Full Name]

Briefly describe your medical billing experience, and familiarity with payer systems.

When applying through OnlineJobs.ph, please use 6 Apply Points.

title: Virtual Assistant Talent Pool Waves 2, 3 and 4
description:
Video applications only. No CV needed. Medyo mahaba-haba ’to, so brace yourselves. 😄



Hi! We’re opening applications for Waves 2, 3, and 4 of our virtual assistant talent pool at our Florida-based agency. Whether you’ve been a VA for years or you’re just getting curious about VA life, we’d love to meet you and hear what kind of work you enjoy.



We review applications in waves and invite shortlisted applicants to a live screening. From there, we make client introductions when there’s an available assignment that fits your skills, schedule, and preferences.



Two ways to work with us:

- Direct placement. We introduce you to a client and help with the handoff. If you both d
 to move forward, you and the client agree on the work, schedule, and pay before you start. Before we hand you off, the client is your point of contact for day-to-day questions, schedule changes, and payments.  

- Agency-managed. You support a client through our agency. We handle your payments, and you’ll have an account manager for check-ins, coaching, and support. If a client stops responding, treats you poorly, or the assignment feels like a poor fit, you can reach out to us. We’ll help you work through it and support you through the transition if the assignment needs to end.



What to share in your video:

Speak in your own words without reading from a script or notes. Imagine we’re already on a call getting to know each other.  



1. Tell us a little about yourself. What does a typical day look like for you? What kind of work do you enjoy, and what are you looking for right now?



2. Share your availability. Which shift can you comfortably commit to each week, 9 AM–1 PM ET (part-time) or 9 AM–5 PM ET (full-time)? When could you start? If you have commitments during your preferred shift, let us know which days and times. You’re welcome to work with other clients as long as the hours you commit to this assignment are set aside for it. Pick a schedule that leaves you enough time to rest, too.



3. Tell us about your workspace and backup plans. What equipment and internet connection do you use? If your Wi-Fi d
 to take the day off, the power goes out, or your computer stops working mid-shift, what’s your plan? Tell us what backups you already have, how quickly you could get back to work, and how you’d let the client or our team know. If you’re still setting something up, just tell us where you’re at with it.



4. Tell us what kind of work and clients suit you. If you’ve worked as a VA before, share one or two types of clients you feel most confident supporting and up to two types of clients or working arrangements you’d rather pass on next time. You’re welcome to tell us why, and you can keep client names private. Then tell us about one of your longest client engagements, how long you worked with them, and one task you handled yourself. Walk us through it from start to finish. Pick something you know well enough to do on your own, even without AI.



New to VA work? You’re welcome to apply! 

What sparked your interest? Maybe a friend told you about it, you saw it on TV, or you were ready for a change from your usual 9-to-5. Tell us what work you’d like to try and share one task you handled at a previous job, at school, while volunteering, or on a personal project. You can also answer this scenario. A customer asks if their appointment is still on for tomorrow, but you can’t find their name on the calendar. What would you check first, and what would you tell them while you look into it?



5. Tell us which setup you prefer. Direct placement, agency-managed, or open to both? If you’re still figuring it out, that’s okay. Tell us what you’re curious about, and we’ll be happy to talk it through with you.



6. Share your thoughts on brief video check-ins. For agency-managed assignments, your account manager or a team member may occasionally hop on a quick live video call during your shift to confirm you’re personally handling the work and see how things are going. It’s also a chance to ask for help if you’re stuck. How do you feel about that, and what kind of support helps you do your best work?



7. Tell us your expected hourly rate in USD.



8. One last question, just for fun. What’s a plot twist in your life you never saw coming? It can be funny, wild, fun fact.. or as simple as 

“I used to champion in singing contest since grade school hanggang ngayon na may mga apo narin...” 

or "I have Bachelor's degree and all pero pucha, hindi pala sapat, kaylangang humarbat para sa kinabukasan walang katapusan".. 

or "I used to worked sa wet market ng tatay ko... okay naman pero I want to give the best life for them too"

or "I'm a balot vendor, but as you can see, I know I can speak confidently and all and I'm positive I have the chance to work as VA.. sakit na sa lalamunan kaka sigaw ng balot sa gabi mem/serrr" 

... Kahit ano go!  Just share whatever you’re comfortable with.  



Screening and submission:

If you’re shortlisted for either setup, you’ll hear from (Jhon, our VA Scout, or Chi, our agency owner), to schedule a live screening before we introduce you to a client. Please have a valid government-issued ID ready to show privately during the call. Keep your ID out of your application video.



Please apply as an independent freelancer. We accept individual applicants only, and you’ll need to personally handle any work you accept.



Send your video application to:  
 subject: VA Talent Pool Wave 2 3 4| Name | City



If you send a video link, please check that we can open it without requesting access.



Thanks for taking the time to introduce yourself. We’d love to hear from you!



Maraming salamat,

Jhon & Chi B.

We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Manager based in the Philippines to join our team on a full-time contractor basis, working directly with our Managing Director.

GoHighLevel (GHL)

Skills get you the interview. Personality gets you the role.



We have worked with remote team members before and we know the difference between someone who just completes tasks and someone who genuinely shows up for the team. We are looking for the latter.



You are the right person if you:

Take pride in your work. Every asset you produce, every campaign you run, every report you send represents Presidential Group. You hold yourself to a high standard because you care about the outcome, not just the task.

This role is a long-term engagement for the right person. We pay well, we treat our team with respect, and we expect the same in return.

Direct working relationship with the Managing Director
