title: AI Creative Designer
description:
AI Creative Designer

Remote, Philippines based, working UK hours.

To apply: send a short Loom video introducing yourself, plus a portfolio that includes both video and static image work. Include at least one example of AI-made or AI-assisted creative and tell us how you made it.



Magnetize is an award-winning, AI-first paid search agency based in Birmingham, UK, with a growing team in the Philippines. We won Lead Gen Campaign of the Year and Start-Up Paid Media Agency of the Year at the 2026 UK Paid Media Awards. Every account here is run by a paid media lead and a data engineer together, supported by Magnetize Pulse, our own AI platform. We are now adding creative as the third discipline.



This is a new role and you will own it. Ad creative has become a performance lever: Performance Max, Demand Gen and Meta all use creative as targeting, so the accounts with the best assets win. You will be the person who makes our ads, concepts and landing page visuals, using AI tools to produce at a pace and volume a traditional designer can't, with the judgement and taste to make the output genuinely good.



What you'll do

• Produce ad creative for our clients across Meta, TikTok and Google (Performance Max, Demand Gen, YouTube): statics, video, and the variants needed to test properly, with paid social as the biggest part of the workload

• Use AI tools as your core workflow for image generation, video generation and editing, and art-direct the output so nothing ships looking like a raw AI generation

• Work to testing plans set with the paid media leads: concepts and hooks built to be measured, iterated on performance data, not opinion

• Design landing page visuals and creative for the journeys we build, working with our web designer

• Build lightweight brand-safe creative systems per client, so assets stay consistent and fast to produce

• Make creative recommendations for clients who have in-house design teams: we supply the thinking and the direction even when they produce the final assets

• Feed what you learn back into the team: which concepts, formats and hooks are winning, and which AI tools are worth adopting



What we're looking for

• A designer first: strong fundamentals in layout, typography and visual hierarchy, with a portfolio that proves taste. AI makes volume cheap, so judgement is what we're hiring

• Hands-on fluency with AI creative tools, image generation, AI video and AI-assisted editing, and the habit of learning new ones as they appear

• Solid craft tools alongside the AI: Figma, Canva and an editing tool you're quick in

• A real understanding of paid social creative: how ads work in feed on Meta and TikTok, hooks and thumb-stopping, platform formats and specs, and why creative is effectively the targeting on these platforms. You don't need to run campaigns, our team does that, but you need to know what makes a social ad perform

• Comfortable with volume and iteration: many variants, fast turnarounds, versioning without losing quality

• Able to take a brief from a paid media lead, push back on it where needed, and present creative thinking to the team clearly

• Self-managing: you'll be the only creative at first, so you set your own standards and workflow

Nice to have: motion design or video editing depth, experience with ecommerce or lead generation brands, UGC-style and creator-led formats, and any experience briefing or working alongside in-house client design teams.



Role details

• Full time, remote, Philippines based, working UK hours

• You'll work directly with the founder, the paid media leads and our web designer

• Pay discussed during the process

This is a build-it role. You'll create the creative function from scratch and shape how creative is done here, the tools, the standards and the workflow. As the agency grows and we win more paid social work, the ambition is a creative team, and the person who built the function is first in line to lead it. There's a lot of room for development for the right person.



How to apply

As above: a short Loom video introducing yourself, plus a portfolio showing both video and static image work, with at least one example of AI-made or AI-assisted creative and how you made it.

The process: a screening call, then a short paid creative task, a real brief of the kind you'd get in the role, and a final call where we review it together and talk through how you approached it.

title: Graphic Designer & Motion Graphics Animator (Remote / Freelance)
description:
TERMS OF REFERENCE (TOR)

Graphic Artist & Animation Specialist

Myst Carnival | Creative Design, Digital Media & Carnival Marketing





1. About Myst Carnival

Myst Carnival is an Antiguan carnival brand dedicated to celebrating Caribbean culture, creativity, entertainment, and the spirit of Antigua's Carnival. Through its events, costumes, digital content, and creative initiatives, Myst seeks to build a distinctive brand identity and contribute to the promotion and growth of Antigua Carnival.



As Myst continues to expand its digital presence, marketing activities, and creative output, it is seeking a talented Graphic Artist & Animation Specialist to support its creative and marketing team. The ideal candidate will have a strong eye for design, the ability to bring concepts to life through animation, and an understanding of how to create engaging visual content that captures attention across digital platforms.



2. Position Overview

Myst Carnival is seeking a creative, versatile, and highly skilled Graphic Artist & Animation Specialist to develop visual content for its carnival brand, events, marketing campaigns, and digital platforms.



The successful candidate will be responsible for producing high-quality graphic designs, animated content, promotional videos, digital advertisements, and other creative assets that help strengthen the Myst brand, generate excitement, engage audiences, and drive participation in its events and activities.



This is a remote, freelance/contract-based position with the potential for ongoing work throughout the year, particularly during the lead-up to Antigua Carnival and other major Myst activities.



3. Scope of Work and Responsibilities

The Graphic Artist & Animation Specialist will work closely with Myst Carnival's management and marketing team to develop and deliver creative content across the following areas:

A. Graphic Design & Branding

- Design visually compelling graphics for social media platforms, including Instagram,
, TikTok, and other digital channels.

- Create flyers, posters, promotional banners, advertisements, event announcements, invitations, and marketing materials.

- Develop campaign graphics for carnival launches, costume reveals, registration, ticket sales, parties, events, and other promotional activities.

- Maintain consistency with Myst Carnival's brand identity, visual style, colors, typography, and overall creative direction.

- Develop graphics for merchandise, souvenirs, promotional products, and other branded materials as required.

- Adapt designs for different formats, platforms, and audiences while maintaining quality and consistency.



B. Animation & Motion Graphics

- Create animated graphics, motion posters, animated flyers, and short promotional clips for social media.

- Develop engaging motion graphics to promote events, carnival costumes, themes, announcements, and campaigns.

- Animate logos, text, images, and graphic elements to create dynamic branded content.

- Produce short-form video content incorporating transitions, visual effects, typography, and motion design.

- Create content suitable for Instagram Reels, TikTok, Stories, and other video-first platforms.

- Incorporate sound effects, music, and audio elements into animations and promotional content where appropriate.



C. Digital Marketing & Content Support

- Collaborate with the marketing team to conceptualize creative ideas and develop campaign visuals.

- Translate marketing briefs, ideas, and concepts into polished and engaging visual content.

- Help generate innovative ideas for digital campaigns that build anticipation, engagement, and excitement around Myst Carnival.

- Support the development of a content calendar by producing creative assets in accordance with campaign timelines.

- Develop visual content that supports audience growth, engagement, costume sales, event attendance, and brand awareness.

- Stay current with emerging design trends, animation styles, digital content formats, and social media trends.



D. Carnival & Event Creative Production

- Develop creative content for carnival-related activities, including:

  - Carnival band launches and announcements.

  - Costume reveals and section launches.

  - Costume promotional campaigns.

  - Event and party promotions.

  - Ticket sales and registration campaigns.

  - Countdown campaigns.

  - Road march and carnival-day content.

  - Post-event highlights and recap content.

- Produce designs and animations that capture the energy, vibrancy, and cultural character of Caribbean Carnival.



4. Key Deliverables

The successful candidate will be expected to produce deliverables including, but not limited to:



Deliverable Description

Social media graphics Static promotional graphics and branded content

Animated flyers Motion-based event flyers and promotional announcements

Motion graphics Logo animation, text animation, visual effects, transitions

Promotional videos Short-form promotional videos for digital platforms

Campaign creatives Coordinated visual assets for launches and marketing campaigns

Carnival content Costume reveals, section announcements, countdowns, event promotions

Digital advertisements Creative assets for paid and organic marketing

Branding assets Supporting graphics, visual templates, and brand elements

Event recap content Animated highlights and promotional post-event visuals



Deliverables will be assigned on an as-needed basis according to Myst Carnival's marketing calendar, campaign requirements, and agreed timelines.



5. Required Qualifications & Experience

Applicants should possess the following qualifications and experience:

- Proven experience in graphic design, digital creative production, motion graphics, and/or animation.

- A strong portfolio demonstrating graphic design skills and animated content.

- Proficiency in industry-standard design and animation software, such as:

  - Adobe Photoshop

  - Adobe Illustrator

  - Adobe After Effects

  - Adobe Premiere Pro

  - Canva (as a supplementary tool)

  - Other relevant graphic design, video editing, or animation software.

- Experience creating content for social media and digital marketing platforms.

- Strong understanding of typography, color theory, composition, layout, and visual storytelling.

- Ability to transform creative briefs and ideas into compelling visual concepts.

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to high-quality output.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple assignments, and meet deadlines.

- Strong communication skills and responsiveness.



6. Preferred Qualifications

The following would be considered an advantage:

- Experience working with carnival bands, festivals, entertainment brands, music, or events.

- Experience creating Caribbean-inspired visual content or working with Caribbean clients.

- Knowledge of social media marketing trends and content strategies.

- Experience with 3D design, character animation, compositing, or advanced motion graphics.

- Ability to contribute creative ideas beyond the execution of assigned designs.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools and workflows.

- Experience creating content designed to generate engagement and excitement, rather than simply producing static designs.



7. Working Arrangement

- Location: Remote

- Engagement: Freelance / Independent Contractor

- Client: Myst Carnival, Antigua & Barbuda

- Duration: Ongoing engagement, subject to performance, creative needs, and mutually agreed terms.

- Working hours: Flexible, with the expectation of availability for communication, coordination, and meeting agreed deadlines.

- Coordination: The specialist will work directly with Myst Carnival's management and marketing team.

The position is remote and open to international applicants. Candidates from the Philippines are encouraged to apply.



8. Performance Expectations

The successful candidate will be evaluated based on:

- Quality, creativity, and originality of design.

- Quality and execution of animations and motion graphics.

- Ability to understand and translate the Myst brand into visual content.

- Timeliness and adherence to agreed delivery schedules.

- Responsiveness to feedback and ability to make revisions.

- Ability to work collaboratively with the marketing team.

- Consistency of output and reliability.

- Ability to contribute fresh ideas and improve the overall creative direction of Myst Carnival.



9. Application Requirements

Interested candidates are required to submit:

1. A current CV or resume.

2. A portfolio showcasing graphic design work.

3. A portfolio of animation, motion graphics, or video work (where available).

4. A brief introduction outlining their experience and interest in the position.

5. Links to relevant online portfolios, Behance, Dribbble, Instagram, Vimeo, or other creative platforms.



10. Practical Test: Myst Carnival Promotional Creative for shortlisted candidates :



Develop:

- One static promotional graphic announcing an upcoming Myst Carnival event or costume launch.

- One 10–15 second animated version of the same graphic suitable for Instagram Reel or Story.

- A brief explanation of their creative approach and the tools used.

Candidates will be provided with a sample Myst logo, a short creative brief, and any relevant brand colors or images.

title: Direct Response Video Editor (VSL Specialist)
description:
I'm the founder of a new E-commerce brand, and I'm building my dream team from the ground up starting with YOU.



This is a rare opportunity to be the FIRST editor on board. That means you're not just another hire lost in a sea of freelancers — you're employee #1 on the creative side. As the brand scales, the people who came in early get the first shot at bigger roles, more responsibility, and leadership positions down the line.



When I grow, you grow. That's the deal.



Your responsibilities



- Primary focus: long-form VSLs (2+ minutes) — structuring hook → problem → agitation → solution → proof → offer, with pacing that holds attention across multiple minutes, not just 15-second hooks

- Edit videos with clean cuts, captions, b-roll, sound design

- K now where to find source stock footage and music

- Keep project files organized (note: start your application with the word PIXEL)

- Turn around edits quickly and handle revisions without ego



Who I'm looking for:

I'm looking for someone hungry and creative who wants to actually matter — not be a tiny cog in a giant machine. Mindset over résumé: fast, organized, detail-obsessed, takes ownership, and handles feedback without taking it personally.



- Solid written and spoken English

- Proven experience editing direct response VSLs that convert — not just short-form social cuts

- Intent-driven editing: every hook, cut, and caption has a purpose, sustained across a long runtime

- Familiarity with AI video tools (Higgsfield, Freepik, ElevenLabs, HeyGen)

- Editing speed

- You actually care if your ad performed or not



The details:



Rate: $3.50/hour

Hours: Per-project / flexible to start, with room to grow into steady weekly hours

Payment: Weekly via Wise



How to apply:



- A short intro about yourself

- Links to 3 of your best edits — at least one should be a VSL of 2+ minutes

- The software you use and your years of experience

- Your favorite ecom brand's VSL or long-form ad, and why it works

- Your weekly availability



Bonus points for a quick Loom video introducing yourself — not required, but it stands out.

title: Social Media Content & Engagement Manager - Entertainment Brand
description:
TERMS OF REFERENCE (TOR)

Social Media Manager

Myst Carnival | Digital Marketing, Brand Growth & Audience Engagement



1. About Myst Carnival

Myst Carnival is an Antiguan carnival brand focused on delivering memorable carnival experiences through costumes, events, entertainment, culture, and creativity. The brand seeks to capture the spirit of Antigua Carnival while building a strong, recognizable identity that resonates with audiences locally, regionally, and internationally.  
 on Instagram.



Myst is looking to strengthen its digital presence and expand its reach through a more strategic, consistent, and engaging social media approach. Social media is a critical tool for building anticipation, growing the Myst community, promoting events and costumes, driving sales, and keeping the brand relevant throughout the year.



Myst Carnival is seeking a creative, digitally savvy, proactive, and results-oriented Social Media Manager to manage its social media platforms, develop content strategies, execute digital campaigns, engage with its audience, and help grow the Myst brand.



This is a remote position suited to someone who understands social media culture, knows how to create excitement around a brand, and can turn content into engagement, community growth, and conversions.



2. Position Overview

The Social Media Manager will be responsible for the planning, management, execution, and growth of Myst Carnival's social media presence across platforms including Instagram,
, TikTok, and other relevant channels.



The successful candidate will develop and implement a content strategy that aligns with Myst Carnival's brand identity, marketing objectives, event calendar, costume launches, and promotional campaigns.



The role goes beyond simply posting content. The Social Media Manager is expected to understand the Myst brand, identify opportunities to increase visibility and engagement, create excitement around carnival, build an active online community, and strategically convert online attention into costume registrations, event attendance, ticket sales, and overall brand growth.



3. Scope of Work & Responsibilities



A. Social Media Strategy & Management

- Develop and implement a comprehensive social media strategy for Myst Carnival.

- Manage and oversee Myst Carnival's social media accounts, including Instagram,
, and TikTok.

- Develop platform-specific strategies to maximize reach, engagement, and audience growth.

- Establish and maintain a consistent brand voice, tone, personality, and visual identity across all platforms.

- Identify opportunities to grow Myst's audience and attract new followers, including international and diaspora audiences.

- Stay informed about social media trends, algorithm changes, platform features, and emerging opportunities.

- Develop strategies to position Myst Carnival as an exciting, aspirational, and recognizable carnival brand.



B. Content Planning & Content Calendar

- Develop and maintain a monthly and weekly social media content calendar.

- Plan content around key milestones, events, campaigns, costume launches, registration periods, and carnival activities.

- Ensure a consistent flow of engaging content throughout the year, not only during the carnival season.

- Coordinate content planning with Myst Carnival's management, graphic designer, animation specialist, photographers, videographers, and other creative team members.

- Identify gaps in content and proactively recommend new ideas and content formats.

- Plan campaign sequences that build anticipation, excitement, and momentum toward major announcements and events.

The Social Media Manager should ensure that content is purposeful and strategically timed, rather than simply posting for the sake of maintaining activity.



C. Content Creation & Creative Direction

The Social Media Manager will be responsible for conceptualizing content and directing the creative approach for Myst Carnival's social media platforms.



Responsibilities include:

- Generate creative ideas for posts, reels, stories, short-form videos, interactive content, and digital campaigns.

- Develop compelling captions, headlines, hooks, calls to action, and storytelling concepts.

- Work closely with the Graphic Artist & Animation Specialist to brief, review, and coordinate creative content.

- Provide clear creative briefs for graphics, animations, videos, and other digital assets.

- Identify opportunities to repurpose existing content into multiple formats and across different social media platforms.

- Develop content that showcases the Myst experience, costumes, masqueraders, events, personalities, culture, behind-the-scenes activities, and lifestyle.

- Ensure content is authentic, exciting, visually consistent, and aligned with the Myst brand.

- Recognize trending content, audio, challenges, memes, and formats that could be adapted to Myst Carnival in a relevant and brand-appropriate way.

The manager is not necessarily expected to personally produce every graphic, animation, or video. However, they must be able to conceptualize content, provide direction, coordinate its production, and ensure that the final product is suitable for publication.



D. Audience Engagement & Community Management

- Actively monitor Myst Carnival's social media platforms and engage with followers.

- Respond to comments, direct messages, inquiries, and audience interactions in a timely, professional, and engaging manner.

- Encourage conversations, sharing, tagging, participation, and user-generated content.

- Develop strategies to increase audience interaction, including polls, Q&As, contests, giveaways, challenges, and interactive stories.

- Build relationships with masqueraders, influencers, event attendees, sponsors, partners, and the wider carnival community.

- Identify opportunities to turn followers into customers, participants, advocates, and brand ambassadors.

- Monitor audience feedback and sentiment and bring relevant insights to Myst Carnival management.

- Escalate sensitive complaints, reputational issues, customer concerns, or matters requiring management intervention.

E. Campaign Development & Execution

- Develop and execute social media campaigns for major Myst Carnival initiatives.

- Create digital campaigns for costume launches, registration, event announcements, ticket sales, promotions, and special initiatives.

- Design campaigns that build anticipation before launches, sustain momentum during promotions, and maintain engagement after events.

- Coordinate countdowns, teasers, reveal campaigns, launch-day content, and follow-up content.

- Develop creative strategies to support sales and conversion objectives.

- Identify opportunities for collaborations, cross-promotions, influencer partnerships, and audience-driven campaigns.

- Track campaign performance and recommend adjustments based on audience response and analytics.

F. Influencer & Partnership Coordination

- Identify relevant influencers, content creators, personalities, and potential brand ambassadors.

- Recommend collaborations that align with Myst Carnival's brand, target audience, and marketing objectives.

- Coordinate influencer campaigns, content collaborations, reposting arrangements, and digital partnerships.

- Help develop influencer briefs, campaign expectations, deliverables, and timelines.

- Track the performance and impact of influencer collaborations.

- Identify opportunities to leverage relationships with other carnival bands, event organizers, artists, DJs, media personalities, and tourism-related brands.

G. Analytics, Reporting & Performance Monitoring

- Monitor social media performance across all platforms.

- Track key performance indicators (KPIs), including:

  - Follower growth.

  - Reach and impressions.

  - Engagement rate.

  - Video views and watch time.

  - Shares, saves, comments, and profile visits.

  - Link clicks and traffic.

  - Audience growth and demographics.

  - Conversion-related metrics, where available.

- Prepare monthly social media performance reports.

- Evaluate the performance of individual posts, campaigns, and content formats.

- Identify what content is performing well and what is not.

- Use insights and data to improve content strategy, posting frequency, timing, and campaign effectiveness.

- Provide recommendations for improving engagement, audience growth, brand awareness, and conversions.



H. Paid Social Media & Advertising Support

- Recommend opportunities for paid social media advertising.

- Assist in developing campaign objectives, target audiences, creative direction, and ad messaging.

- Coordinate with Myst Carnival management on campaign budgets and advertising priorities.

- Monitor paid campaign performance where advertising campaigns are assigned.

- Recommend adjustments to targeting, creative content, placements, and campaign strategy.

- Report on advertising effectiveness and return on marketing investment, where data is available.



The Social Media Manager will not independently commit or spend advertising funds without prior approval from Myst 

Carnival management.

I. Carnival Coverage & Real-Time Content

During the lead-up to Antigua Carnival and major Myst events, the Social Media Manager will play a key role in ensuring the brand maintains a high level of online activity and audience engagement.



Responsibilities include:

- Develop a social media plan for the carnival season and major events.

- Coordinate the timely release of content before, during, and after events.

- Plan real-time content opportunities, including Stories, short videos, backstage content, behind-the-scenes footage, and audience highlights.

- Coordinate with on-ground photographers, videographers, and team members to ensure relevant content is captured and delivered.

- Identify key moments and experiences that should be shared to maximize audience engagement.

- Ensure content is published promptly during major events, where access to content and necessary approvals are available.

- Develop post-event recap campaigns to extend the life and reach of Myst's events and carnival participation.



4. Key Deliverables

The Social Media Manager will be responsible for delivering the following on a recurring basis.

Weekly deliverables

- Weekly content plan and posting schedule.

- Scheduled and published content across agreed platforms.

- Caption writing and creative briefs.

- Community engagement and inbox monitoring.

- Trend identification and content recommendations.



Monthly deliverables

- Monthly content calendar.

- Social media performance report and analytics.

- Audience growth and engagement analysis.

- Review of successful and underperforming content.

- Recommendations for the upcoming month's content and campaigns.

- Proposed campaign ideas and promotional opportunities.



Campaign deliverables

- Campaign concept and strategy.

- Campaign timeline and content schedule.

- Creative briefs and content direction.

- Campaign execution and audience engagement.

- Post-campaign analysis and recommendations.



5. Expected Content Output

The Social Media Manager will be expected to maintain an active, consistent, and engaging social media presence for Myst Carnival.



The anticipated output will be agreed with management based on the campaign calendar, available content, and production capacity. As a guide, the role may include:

Content type Indicative frequency

Feed posts / carousels 3–5 per week

Reels / short-form videos 2–4 per week

Stories 5–7 days per week

Interactive content (polls, Q&A, etc.) 2–3 per week

Campaigns / activations As required by marketing calendar

Community engagement Daily monitoring



These are indicative targets, not rigid quotas. Content quality, relevance, strategic timing, and audience engagement will take priority over posting volume.

6. Required Qualifications & Experience

Applicants should possess:

- Proven experience managing social media accounts for brands, businesses, events, entertainment, or lifestyle organizations.

- Demonstrated ability to grow social media audiences and increase engagement.

- Strong understanding of Instagram,
, TikTok, and emerging digital platforms.

- Experience developing social media content strategies and content calendars.

- Excellent copywriting skills, including captions, promotional messaging, storytelling, and calls to action.

- Strong understanding of digital marketing, audience behavior, trends, and platform algorithms.

- Ability to interpret analytics and use performance data to inform content decisions.

- Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

- Excellent communication skills and responsiveness.

- Creativity, initiative, attention to detail, and a strong sense of brand identity.

7. Preferred Qualifications

The following would be considered an advantage:

- Experience working with carnival bands, festivals, entertainment brands, events, tourism, fashion, music, or lifestyle brands.

- Experience marketing to Caribbean audiences or international diaspora communities.

- Experience managing social media accounts with a strong visual and entertainment focus.

- Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, TikTok analytics, Instagram Insights, scheduling tools, and social listening platforms.

- Experience coordinating graphic designers, video editors, animators, photographers, and content creators.

- Experience with influencer marketing and digital collaborations.

- Basic graphic design, video editing, or content production skills.

- Experience using AI tools to support content ideation, research, planning, copywriting, and analytics.



8. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Social Media Manager's performance will be assessed based on a combination of growth, engagement, content quality, execution, and contribution to Myst Carnival's marketing objectives.

Performance area KPI / measurement

Audience growth Consistent growth in followers and relevant audiences

Engagement Improvement in engagement rates and audience interaction

Content performance Reach, shares, saves, views, watch time, and performance of content

Consistency Timely and consistent delivery of the content calendar

Campaign execution Successful delivery of campaigns according to agreed timelines

Community management Timely responses and effective audience engagement

Creativity Fresh, relevant, and innovative content ideas

Conversion Contribution to registrations, ticket sales, costume sales, inquiries, and traffic

Reporting Timely and accurate monthly reporting and insights

Initiative Proactive identification of trends, opportunities, and marketing ideas



KPIs will be reviewed periodically with Myst Carnival management and adjusted based on the season, campaign objectives, platform performance, and available resources.

9. Working Arrangement

Item Details

Location Remote

Client Myst Carnival, Antigua & Barbuda

Engagement type Freelance / Independent Contractor

Duration Ongoing engagement, subject to performance and mutual agreement

Working hours Flexible, with agreed availability and deadlines

Reporting to Myst Carnival Management / Marketing Lead

Coordination Graphic Artist, Animation Specialist, Photographers, Videographers, Event Team, and Management



The Social Media Manager must be comfortable working across different time zones, particularly coordinating with the Myst team in Antigua and other international creative personnel.



The role requires flexibility during key campaign periods, costume launches, registration deadlines, events, and Antigua Carnival season.

10. Professional Standards & Brand Guidelines

The Social Media Manager is expected to:

- Maintain a professional and consistent representation of the Myst Carnival brand.

- Ensure all content is factually accurate and approved where necessary before publication.

- Maintain confidentiality regarding internal business matters, unreleased costumes, campaigns, events, and marketing plans.

- Ensure that copyrighted images, music, videos, and other creative materials are used appropriately.

- Obtain management approval for sensitive announcements, major campaigns, promotional partnerships, and content that may affect the brand's reputation.

- Ensure all social media accounts, passwords, content assets, audience data, and campaign materials remain the property of Myst Carnival.

- Maintain proper organization of content, campaign files, reporting, and relevant digital assets.

- Follow agreed communication, approval, and reporting procedures.

11. Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit:

1. A current CV or resume.

2. A portfolio of social media accounts they have managed or contributed to.

3. Examples of campaigns, content strategies, or social media growth initiatives.

4. A brief description of their experience managing social media for a brand, business, event, or organization.

5. Examples of content calendars, campaign plans, or monthly reports, where available (sensitive client information may be redacted).

6. Their expected monthly retainer, hourly rate, or project-based fee.

7. Confirmation of availability and preferred working arrangement.

8. A short statement outlining what they believe makes a carnival or entertainment brand successful on social media.

Candidates should ideally provide examples of actual accounts they have managed and explain their role in the growth, engagement, or performance of those accounts.

12. Practical Assessment for Shortlisted Candidates

Shortlisted applicants may be required to complete a practical assessment to demonstrate their strategic thinking, creativity, and understanding of social media marketing.

Assessment: Myst Carnival Social Media Campaign



Candidates will be asked to develop a brief social media campaign for Myst Carnival based on a scenario provided by management.



The assignment may include:

- A proposed 7-day social media content plan.

- Three sample social media captions.

- Two campaign ideas designed to generate engagement and excitement.

- One concept for a Reel or TikTok video.

- A brief explanation of how they would grow engagement and reach new audiences.

- A proposed approach to converting followers into costume registrants, event attendees, or customers.

The candidate should demonstrate strategic thinking, creativity, an understanding of social media trends, and an ability to develop content that is appropriate for the Myst Carnival brand.



Candidates should be evaluated on the quality of their ideas, creativity, strategic thinking, understanding of the audience, practicality of execution, and ability to connect social media activity to tangible marketing outcomes.





Remote | Freelance / Contract | International Client



14. What Myst Is Really Looking For

The ideal candidate should:

- Think strategically: Understand what Myst is trying to achieve and why each post, campaign, and piece of content is being published.

- Be creative: Bring fresh ideas, trends, concepts, and approaches without needing constant direction.

- Understand hype and anticipation: Know how to create suspense around costume launches, event announcements, and major carnival moments.

- Understand the culture: Appreciate the energy, lifestyle, community, and excitement of Caribbean Carnival.

- Be commercially minded: Understand that social media should ultimately help drive ticket sales, registrations, costume sales, engagement, and brand growth.

- Take initiative: Come to the table with ideas and recommendations rather than waiting to be told what to post.

- Be organized and dependable: Plan ahead, meet deadlines, and keep the content pipeline moving.

- Understand storytelling: Make people feel like they want to be part of Myst, not just look at its posts.

title: Commercial Cleaning Operations & Lead Generation VA
description:
Location — Remote, Philippines-based

Schedule — Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time (Fort Worth, Texas), with a one-hour break. This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role.



You must be available for the full overnight shift in the Philippines. Shifts begin Monday through Friday night and end the following morning.

- During U.S. Central Standard Time (CST) — 10:00 p.m.–7:00 a.m. Philippine time.

- During U.S. Central Daylight Time (CDT) — 9:00 p.m.–6:00 a.m. Philippine time.

We’re launching a commercial cleaning business in the Fort Worth, Texas area. We’re looking for an experienced virtual assistant to help build and oversee our local cleaning team, coordinate jobs, and bring in new commercial clients. You’ll work directly with the owner.



What you’ll do

- Find and screen local cleaners, conduct initial interviews, recommend candidates for approval, and help onboard approved hires.

- Schedule cleaning crews, confirm job details, arrange backup coverage when someone calls out, and follow up on client concerns or missed work.

- Research local offices, property management companies, and other businesses that may need recurring cleaning. Identify who handles their cleaning contracts.

- Make outbound calls, send personalized
s and texts, and follow up with prospects. Ask about their cleaning needs and book walkthroughs for the owner.

- Track cleaner candidates, outreach, booked walkthroughs, and job coverage. Send the owner a short weekly update on progress and anything that needs attention.



Tools and work setup

- Google Workspace for
, calendars, documents, and spreadsheets.

- GoHighLevel for tracking leads, follow-ups, and appointments.

- Google Voice for business calls and text messages.

You’ll need reliable internet and a quiet workspace for calls. A backup connection, such as a mobile hotspot, is strongly preferred. Notify the owner as soon as possible if an internet outage, power outage, or equipment issue interrupts your shift. Time you’re unable to work due to an outage or technical issue on your end is unpaid where permitted by applicable law. Any time you continue working using a backup setup is paid.

What we’re looking for

- At least two years of relevant experience in cleaning or another service business, including coordinating crews and contacting business prospects.

- Experience screening candidates, managing schedules, and handling last-minute changes.

- Strong spoken and written English and confidence calling U.S. businesses.

- Experience with Google Workspace and a system for tracking leads. GoHighLevel experience is a plus.

- Availability for the full overnight schedule above, including the one-hour change when U.S. daylight saving time begins or ends.

- Experience with U.S. commercial cleaning or janitorial services is strongly preferred.



How to apply

 Start your application message with the word CLEANING on its own line. Applications that don’t begin with CLEANING won’t be considered for an interview.

1. Submit your résumé as a PDF or a link we can open.

2. Include a 60–90 second voice recording in English. Upload the recording or share a link we can open. Introduce yourself, explain why you’re qualified, and give a short example of what you’d say when calling a Fort Worth office manager about their cleaning needs.

3. Share two brief examples from previous work. Tell us about a crew you helped recruit or manage and a time you generated leads or booked appointments. Include numbers if you have them, such as crew size or walkthroughs booked.

4. Share your earliest start date and confirm that you can work both Philippine shift times listed above.

5. Include your expected monthly pay in USD for this full-time, 40-hour-per-week role.

title: Outbound Sales Closer, Vacation Rentals (GoHighLevel, High-Volume Calls)
description:
Type of work: Full-time

Schedule: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday

Pay: USD 2.50 per hour + 0.75% commission on the booking value of every booking you close



About us



W&K Reserve runs large vacation homes in the Poconos, Pennsylvania, for families and groups. Every day people ask us about a stay through our ads and website. We need a salesperson who calls those leads quickly, finds the right home for them, and gets the booking confirmed.



This is a closing job, not appointment setting. You own the call from first hello to confirmed booking.



What you will do



 • Make a high volume of outbound calls every day to leads who asked about booking a vacation rental.

 • Call new leads within minutes of their inquiry.

 • Ask about dates, group size, occasion and budget, then recommend the right home.

 • Quote the price, handle objections, and close the booking on the call.

 • Follow up by call, text and
 until the lead books or says no.

 • Manage every lead in GoHighLevel: pipeline stages, notes, tasks and follow-ups.

 • Send a short end-of-day report with calls made, conversations, quotes and bookings.



Requirements



 • At least 2 years of phone sales experience where you closed the sale yourself (not only setting appointments or transferring calls).

 • Proven results you can state in numbers: close rate, sales per month, or quota attainment.

 • Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent that US customers understand easily.

 • Hands-on experience using GoHighLevel to manage leads and pipelines.

 • Comfortable making 100+ calls per day.

 • Confident handling price objections and asking for the booking.

 • Quiet workspace, noise-cancelling headset, stable internet (at least 25 Mbps) and a backup connection.

 • Able to work the full US Eastern shift.



Nice to have



 • Experience selling travel, hotels, vacation rentals or other bookings.

 • Experience following up inbound leads from US customers.



How to apply



 
 with the subject line "Sales Closer – [Your Name]" and include:



 1. Your resume.

 2. A 1–2 minute voice recording (a Vocaroo link is fine) introducing yourself and describing the best sale you ever closed.

 3. Answers to these questions:

 • In your last closing role, what was your close rate and how many sales did you close per month?

 • What did you sell, and what was the average sale value?

 • Describe exactly how you used GoHighLevel day to day.

 • How many calls per day did you make in your last calling role?

 • A lead says, "It's a bit more than we wanted to spend." What do you say?



Applications without the voice recording and the answers will not be reviewed.

title: Experienced Amazon Marketplace Sales Specialist (VA)

We are looking for an experienced Amazon Sales Specialist to manage and grow our business across U.S. and international Amazon marketplaces.



The ideal candidate has at least 2 years of hands-on experience with the Amazon U.S. marketplace, strong Amazon PPC skills, and a proven ability to improve sales, profitability, and listing performance.



Note: Creating listings for new products is not required. Optimizing existing listings is essential.

- Create, manage, and optimize PPC campaigns, including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.

- Monitor ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR, CPC, and conversion rates.

- Optimize existing listings through keyword research, SEO, and conversion improvements.

- Analyze competitors, sales reports, rankings, and product performance.

- Manage promotions, coupons, inventory monitoring, and account health.

- Identify growth opportunities and provide regular performance reports.



Requirements



- Minimum 2 years of experience managing the Amazon U.S. marketplace.

title: Accountant Remote
description:
TERMS OF REFERENCE (TOR)



Accountant – Myst Carnival & Caribbean Living Antigua



Position: Part-Time Accountant 

Location: Remote

Engagement: Freelance / Contract

Client: Myst Carnival & Caribbean Living Antigua



1. Background



Myst Carnival and Caribbean Living Antigua are two businesses operating in Antigua & Barbuda with distinct operational and financial requirements.



Myst Carnival is engaged in carnival, entertainment, events, costume sales, and related activities, involving seasonal revenue, event expenditure, costume production, supplier payments, and customer collections.



Caribbean Living Antigua is a residential and commercial property rental business, generating income through residential tenancy and commercial office rentals. Its operations involve rent collection, lease management, tenant accounts, property maintenance, and property-related expenses.



Both businesses are seeking a reliable, organized, and experienced Accountant to manage their bookkeeping and accounting functions, maintain accurate financial records, monitor cash flow, and provide management with timely financial information to support business decisions.



2. Position Overview



The Accountant will manage the day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping functions for Myst Carnival and Caribbean Living Antigua using QuickBooks, which is the accounting software currently used by the businesses.



The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate and up-to-date financial records, monitoring income and expenses, managing accounts receivable and payable, reconciling bank accounts, and preparing monthly financial reports.



The position requires someone who is proactive, detail-oriented, comfortable working independently, and able to manage the accounting requirements of two businesses with different operating models.



3. Scope of Work & Responsibilities



A. General Accounting & Bookkeeping



Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records in QuickBooks for both businesses.



Record and categorize income, expenses, payments, purchases, and other financial transactions.



Maintain separate accounting records for each business.



Organize invoices, receipts, bank statements, and supporting financial documents.



Ensure transactions are accurately recorded and accounts are kept current.



Review financial records for discrepancies, missing transactions, or errors.



B. Accounts Receivable & Accounts Payable



Monitor income and outstanding customer balances for both businesses.



Track payments received and follow up on overdue accounts.



Maintain accounts receivable and accounts payable records.



Monitor supplier invoices, payment due dates, and outstanding obligations.



Prepare payment schedules and provide management with advance notice of upcoming payments.



Reconcile customer payments and supplier accounts against accounting records.



C. Bank Reconciliation & Cash Management



Perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations.



Reconcile transactions recorded in QuickBooks against bank statements and payment platforms.



Monitor cash balances and expected cash inflows and outflows.



Prepare and maintain cash flow forecasts.



Identify potential cash flow shortfalls and bring them to management's attention.



D. Financial Reporting & Management Accounts



Prepare monthly financial reports for each business, including:



Profit & Loss Statement.



Balance Sheet.



Accounts receivable and accounts payable summaries.



Budget versus actual expenditure, where applicable.



Financial performance commentary highlighting significant variances, outstanding balances, and issues requiring management attention.



Reports should be presented clearly and in a format that allows management to quickly understand the financial position and performance of each business.



4. Caribbean Living Antigua – Property Rental Accounting



The Accountant will be responsible for maintaining the financial records associated with Caribbean Living Antigua's residential and commercial rental portfolio.



Responsibilities include:



Maintain an accurate rent roll and tenant ledger for all residential and commercial rental units.



Track rental amounts due, payments received, outstanding balances, and arrears.



Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue tenant payments.



Maintain records of lease terms, rental amounts, lease expirations, renewals, and security deposits.



Track property-related expenses, including maintenance, repairs, utilities, insurance, contractors, and other operating costs.



Maintain expense records by property, where applicable.



Monitor occupancy and vacancy-related rental income.



Prepare property income and expense summaries to assess the financial performance of individual properties.



Identify unusual expenses, recurring maintenance costs, and potential issues affecting property profitability.



The Accountant should ensure management has a clear overview of rental income, arrears, occupancy, property expenses, and the overall financial performance of the rental portfolio.



5. Myst Carnival – Event & Carnival Accounting



The Accountant will manage the accounting and financial tracking associated with Myst Carnival's events, costume sales, and carnival operations.



Responsibilities include:



Track costume sales, registrations, installment payments, deposits, and outstanding customer balances.



Monitor ticket sales, event revenue, sponsorships, and other income.



Record costume production costs, freight, customs, logistics, and supplier expenses.



Track event expenditure, including venues, entertainment, production, marketing, security, and other operating costs.



Maintain budgets and track expenditure against approved event budgets.



Prepare financial summaries for individual events and projects.



Monitor event profitability and identify cost overruns or financial concerns.



Assist management with cash flow planning for costume production and upcoming events.



6. Budgeting & Financial Planning



Assist with the preparation and monitoring of operating budgets for both businesses.



Track actual expenditure against budgets.



Prepare cash flow forecasts based on expected income and upcoming obligations.



Monitor major expenses, financial commitments, and cash requirements.



Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and financial performance.



Provide financial information and analysis to support management decisions.



7. Qualifications & Experience



Applicants should possess:



A degree, diploma, or professional qualification in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.



At least 5 years of relevant accounting or bookkeeping experience.



Strong, demonstrated proficiency in QuickBooks is essential. Candidates must have practical experience using QuickBooks to maintain accounting records and prepare financial reports.



Experience with bookkeeping, bank reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and financial reporting.



Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.



Experience managing accounts for multiple businesses or clients.



Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to meet deadlines.



Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.



High level of integrity, reliability, professionalism, and confidentiality.



8. Preferred Experience



The following would be an advantage:



Experience in residential and commercial property rental accounting.



Experience managing rent rolls, tenant ledgers, arrears, security deposits, and property expenses.



Experience with event, entertainment, hospitality, or seasonal businesses.



Familiarity with property-level income and expense tracking.



Experience preparing management accounts and cash flow forecasts.



Knowledge of small business financial management.



9. Performance Expectations



The Accountant will be expected to:



Maintain accurate and current accounting records in QuickBooks.



Ensure monthly accounts are reconciled and financial reports are prepared on time.



Keep management informed of outstanding receivables, arrears, upcoming obligations, and cash flow concerns.



Maintain accurate rental records and promptly identify overdue tenant accounts.



Track property and event expenses and provide visibility into profitability.



Work independently, proactively, and with minimal supervision.



Communicate clearly and respond promptly to management requests.



10. Working Arrangement



Location: Remote



Engagement: Part-Time / Freelance / Contract



Duration: Ongoing, subject to performance and mutual agreement



Reporting to: Owner / Management



Working hours: Flexible, based on agreed workload and deadlines



Software: QuickBooks (mandatory), Excel/Google Sheets, and cloud-based document storage



The engagement will be based primarily on agreed responsibilities and deliverables, with the expectation that both businesses' accounts remain current and management receives timely financial information.



11. Confidentiality



The Accountant will be required to maintain strict confidentiality regarding all financial, commercial, tenant, customer, supplier, and operational information relating to Myst Carnival and Caribbean Living Antigua.



All financial records, accounting files, reports, spreadsheets, and work products developed or maintained during the engagement shall remain the property of the respective business.



12. Application Requirements



Interested candidates should submit:



A current CV or resume.



A summary of relevant accounting and bookkeeping experience.



Confirmation of their QuickBooks experience, including the functions and types of accounts they have managed.



Experience managing accounts for multiple businesses or clients.



Relevant experience in property rental accounting and/or event accounting.



Their expected monthly fee or hourly rate.



Confirmation of availability and preferred working arrangement.



Candidates must demonstrate strong QuickBooks proficiency and the ability to independently manage the accounting records of two businesses.



13. Practical Assessment



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short practical assessment involving sample transactions for both businesses.



The assessment may include:



Recording and categorizing transactions in QuickBooks.



Reconciling a bank statement.



Preparing a simple Profit & Loss Statement.



Reviewing a rent roll and identifying outstanding tenant balances.



Summarizing property income and expenses.



Reviewing event revenue and expenditure.



Identifying discrepancies and providing a brief financial summary for management.



The assessment will focus on accuracy, QuickBooks proficiency, organization, financial analysis, and the ability to communicate accounting information clearly.



14. Ideal Candidate Profile



The ideal candidate is a dependable and proactive accounting professional who can take ownership of the financial records of both businesses without requiring constant supervision.



They should be comfortable managing routine accounting functions, maintaining accurate records, monitoring rental income and arrears, tracking event expenditure, reconciling accounts, and preparing management reports.



The successful candidate should be someone who keeps the books current, anticipates issues, communicates proactively, and provides management with confidence that the financial position of both Myst Carnival and Caribbean Living Antigua is accurate, organized, and readily understood.

title: Online Marketing & Social Media Manager (Organic Marketing, Content & Funnels)
description:
Ready to Move Beyond Social Media Execution?

=======================================

Maybe you started your career as a virtual assistant and discovered that marketing was where you really excelled. Or perhaps you've already built your career as a Social Media Manager or Online Marketing Manager.

You've created content, managed social media channels, worked with analytics, and learned what makes audiences engage and take action.

Now you're looking for something more.

You don't want to spend your career waiting for someone to assign your next task. You want to contribute ideas, make decisions, own projects, and see the business impact of your work.

That's the opportunity we're offering.

We're looking for an experienced, creative, and action-oriented Marketing & Growth Manager who combines strong marketing judgment with hands-on execution.

You'll collaborate directly with our founder, help shape our organic growth strategy, and take increasing ownership of marketing performance. You'll have room to bring your own ideas, experiment with new approaches, and develop into a broader marketing leadership role as the business grows.



About Us

=========

We are an established and growing B2C online education and coaching business specializing in relationships and interpersonal dynamics. Through our digital courses and coaching programs, we help people navigate relationship challenges, develop healthier relationship patterns, and create meaningful change in their personal lives.

We already have an established customer acquisition system powered by Meta Ads. Now, we're ready to take our organic marketing to the next level.

Our ambition is to build a stronger, more recognizable presence across Instagram, TikTok, podcasts, Google, and AI-powered search platforms—expanding our reach, attracting new audiences, and turning organic visibility into qualified leads and sales.

A key part of this journey is evolving from a primarily expert-led educational brand into a more personality-driven personal brand built on genuine expertise. We want to combine valuable relationship education with engaging storytelling, fresh perspectives, authentic personality, and content that connects with a broader audience.

We're looking for someone who is excited to help shape and execute this next chapter of our growth.



What You'll Be Doing

======================

1. Own Our Organic Content Strategy and Execution (Instagram, Podcast, SEO Blog posts, AI searchability, etc.)

2. Connect Content to Leads and Sales

3. Help us build a Stronger Personal Brand on Instagram

4. Grow Our Podcast, get us on other podcast shows and Search Visibility

5. Analyze Performance and Improve Results

6. Build Smarter Marketing Systems (improve templates, workflows, use AI tools, agents, and automation)

What We're Looking For

=========================

Required Experience and Skills

=========================

Proven professional experience as a Social Media Manager, Online Marketing Manager, Content Marketing Manager, or in a comparable role.

A demonstrable track record of managing social media content and contributing to measurable marketing results.

Strong understanding of organic Instagram marketing, short-form video, audience growth, and content strategy.

Experience creating content for different stages of the marketing funnel—not just top-of-funnel engagement.

Excellent English copywriting skills, particularly for attention-grabbing hooks, persuasive storytelling, scripts, and conversion-oriented content.

Strong hands-on skills in Canva and short-form video editing. You should be comfortable producing high-quality content efficiently.

Experience managing content calendars, repurposing existing material, and maintaining organized publishing workflows.

Ability to interpret social media analytics and turn performance data into practical recommendations.

Understanding of Instagram lead generation, ManyChat or similar DM automation tools, and the relationship between content and sales.

Strong organizational skills, reliability, and the ability to manage your work independently.

Clear, proactive written and verbal communication skills.

Especially Valuable

===============

Experience marketing digital courses, coaching programs, educational products, or other B2C online offers.

Experience working with a founder-led business or personal brand.

Familiarity with Meta Ads creative strategy and how organic content can support paid acquisition.

Podcast editing, production, or guest outreach experience.

SEO content creation and familiarity with AI search visibility.

Experience with marketing automation tools such as Pabbly Connect, Make, Zapier, or similar platforms.

Practical experience using AI to accelerate content production and improve marketing workflows.

You don't need to be an expert in every tool or channel. But you should already have strong marketing fundamentals and the confidence to learn, experiment, and solve problems independently.

How You Work

==================

We're looking for someone with a particular combination of qualities.

Creative and action-oriented. You can come up with original, compelling ideas—and you enjoy bringing them to life. You're not someone who only strategizes or someone who only executes instructions.

Comfortable collaborating with a founder. You enjoy brainstorming, co-creating, sharing your opinions, and respectfully challenging ideas when you see a better approach.

Direct and proactive in your communication. You speak up when you need information, feedback, resources, or support. You raise challenges early and come with possible solutions.

Commercially minded. You understand that reach and engagement matter, but marketing ultimately needs to generate qualified leads, sales opportunities, and revenue.

Independent and accountable. You take ownership of outcomes, manage priorities, follow through on commitments, and don't need constant supervision.

Curious and improvement-oriented. You enjoy learning new tools, experimenting with AI, improving workflows, and finding smarter ways to achieve results.

If you've previously worked as a virtual assistant, that's absolutely welcome. What matters is that you've since developed proven marketing expertise and are now ready for a position with greater ownership and responsibility.

What Success Looks Like

Your success will be measured by the impact of our marketing, not simply the number of tasks completed.

Our key priorities include:

Qualified organic leads: Increasing the number and quality of leads generated through Instagram and related funnels.

Core-offer sales: Growing sales and revenue influenced by our organic marketing efforts.

High-ticket opportunities: Generating qualified sales opportunities for our premium coaching programs.

Audience growth and visibility: Increasing Instagram reach, non-follower exposure, and relevant follower growth.

Brand development: Building a recognizable, engaging personal brand that combines personality with expertise.

Podcast and search presence: Maintaining consistent podcast activity and improving discoverability through Google and AI-powered search.

Operational efficiency: Maintaining strong content output while continuously improving quality, production speed, and repeatable systems.

We'll work together to establish meaningful baselines, reporting, and targets. We understand that results depend on collaboration across marketing, sales, and the broader business.

What This Opportunity Offers

A full-time, remote position with an established and ambitious online business.

Direct collaboration with the founder and meaningful involvement in marketing decisions.

The opportunity to own projects, contribute ideas, and see the commercial results of your work.

An existing foundation of educational content, brand expertise, paid acquisition, and internal team support.

Space to experiment with new content formats, marketing approaches, AI tools, and automation.

The potential to grow into a broader marketing leadership role as the business expands, with future opportunities to help build and guide a production team.

This is a hands-on role today, with the potential to become a leadership role within 1-2 years.



How to Apply

=============

Please submit your application together with your cv, portfolio and VOPS quiz results here: 
 



We're looking for someone who already knows how to do marketing—and is excited to take ownership of what marketing achieves.

title: AI Static Ad Creator (Higgsfield / Nano Banana) — DTC E-com | Long-Term
description:
About the role 

We're a fast-scaling DTC e-commerce brand and almost all our static ads are made with AI. 

A lot of our best performers are native-style ads, built to blend into the feed and look like organic content, not ads. 

You work inside a small creative pod as our production engine for statics: you take the angles, copy and prompts from our Creative Strategist and turn them into a high volume of ready-to-run static ads at speed. 

This is a long-term role, not a one-off gig.



Where you fit 

Our Creative Strategist owns the angles, hooks and copy. You own the production: turning those into finished, test-ready statics, fast, consistent, at volume.



What you'll deliver (daily)

- As many finished statics as the test roadmap needs, a steady daily output, no hand-holding

- Multiple execution variations per concept (layouts, backgrounds, formats) so we can test fast

- Native-style statics, advertorials, text-post/screenshot styles, organic-looking UGC, plus comparison-/offer-style image ads, all built with AI

- First version same day, revisions within 24h

- Correct formats (1:1, 4:5, 9:16), clean naming, upload-ready





Tools you master

- AI image: Higgsfield + Nano Banana (MUST, we build almost everything with these)

- Finishing (only when needed): Canva

- Communication: Slack

- Organisation: Notion (or similar)



How you work, this matters most

- Self-managing: you take a brief + prompts from the strategist and run with it. No call needed for every change.

- Strong prompting: you get the exact result through fast, deliberate iteration, not luck.

- Analytical eye: you reverse-engineer why an ad works and prompt accordingly.

- You get native ads: you can make a static feel organic, like a real post, not a banner.

- You think along: you actively suggest how to make the creatives better, not just execute.

- Fast: speed is a core part of this role.



Requirements

- Real experience with DTC/e-com static ads

- AI-native, you build with these tools every day

- You understand hooks, offers and conversion (even though the strategist sets them)

- You can accurately place provided copy into a design, including native text (you don't need to speak it; you follow the strategist's copy exactly)

- Reliable internet + able to overlap a few hours with European (CET) working hours

- Start your application with the word "SCROLL" or it gets deleted



Not for

- Beginners or "design-only" profiles who can't prompt AI

- People who've "tried Midjourney once"

- Slow executors who need a call for every change



How we start 

Paid test: 1 brief ? 3 static concepts in Higgsfield / Nano Banana in 48h, with the prompts you used. We hire on that, not on a portfolio.



To apply, send:

- 2–3 ad creatives you made with AI (links) + which tools

- 1–2 of the actual prompts you used

- Your rate (monthly or per-deliverable)

- Begin with "SCROLL"
